item.title: TALON框架为每个增量任务分配独立的LoRA教师进行任务特定学习，再通过集成知识蒸馏将多个冻结教师蒸馏为统一的LoRA学生模型，实现了免运行时模块选择的推理高效少样本类增量学习。
item.description:
解耦与蒸馏：面向少样本类增量学习的任务自适应LoRA-教师与集成知识迁移

Decoupled and Distilled: Task-Adaptive LoRA-Teachers with Ensemble Knowledge Transfer for Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39390

TALON框架为每个增量任务分配独立的LoRA教师进行任务特定学习，再通过集成知识蒸馏将多个冻结教师蒸馏为统一的LoRA学生模型，实现了免运行时模块选择的推理高效少样本类增量学习。

少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）致力于解决在样本极其有限的情况下学习新类别、同时保留已学类别知识的挑战。尽管基于预训练模型的参数高效微调方法在类增量学习中展现出潜力，但在数据严重稀缺的条件下，严格的基于梯度的约束可能并不可靠，而多专家方法则会带来较高的推理时间成本。我们提出了TALON（Task-Adaptive LoRA-Teachers with Ensemble Knowledge Transfer，任务自适应LoRA-教师与集成知识迁移），一种推理高效的FSCIL框架。TALON为每个增量任务动态分配一个独立的LoRA-教师，用于任务特定的表示学习，然后通过集成知识蒸馏将多个冻结的教师模型蒸馏到一个统一的LoRA-学生模型中，从而避免了运行时的模块选择或生成。一种语义引导的蒸馏策略根据特征空间相似性对教师模型的贡献进行加权，以缓解……

arXiv:2609.39390v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL) addresses the challenge of learning new classes from very limited samples while retaining knowledge of previously learned ones. Although parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods with pre-trained models show promise for class-incremental learning, strict gradient-based constraints can be unreliable under severe data scarcity, while multi-expert approaches can impose substantial inference-time costs. We propose TALON (Task-Adaptive LoRA-Teachers with Ensemble Knowledge Transfer), an inference-efficient FSCIL framework. TALON dynamically allocates an independent LoRA-Teacher to each incremental task for task-specific representation learning, then distills multiple frozen teachers into a unified LoRA-Student through Ensemble Knowledge Transfer, eliminating runtime module selection or generation. item.title: 提出R²NO框架，先在真实数据上微调并冻结预训练算子以提供源预测，再利用基于傅里叶域分区（径向、角度、通道）的频谱集成修复模块学习细化，从而在保留预训练结构的同时将仿真预训练的神经算子高效适配到真实世界数据。
item.description:
超越仿真：面向真实世界适应的保留与修复神经算子

Beyond Simulation: Retain-and-Repair Neural Operators for Real-World Adaptation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39387

提出R²NO框架，先在真实数据上微调并冻结预训练算子以提供源预测，再利用基于傅里叶域分区（径向、角度、通道）的频谱集成修复模块学习细化，从而在保留预训练结构的同时将仿真预训练的神经算子高效适配到真实世界数据。

神经算子越来越受益于在数值仿真上的预训练，然而将其适配到真实世界预测仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了保留与修复神经算子（R²NO），这是一个在将仿真预训练算子适配到真实世界数据的同时保留有用预训练结构的框架。预训练算子首先在真实数据上进行微调，然后被冻结以提供源预测，同时一个共享的修复模块从相同的观测中学习一系列细化。利用正交傅里叶投影，一个频谱集成在傅里叶域的每个单元内拟合一个小型岭回归，并通过在真实数据留出集上拟合的权重来组合这些细化。这些单元由径向范围、角度扇区和测量通道共同定义，使得细化深度可以随频率幅值、方向以及跨通道而变化。将源预测纳入……

arXiv:2609.39387v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural operators increasingly benefit from pretraining on numerical simulations, yet adapting them for real-world prediction remains challenging. We introduce the Retain-and-Repair Neural Operator (R$^2$NO), a framework for adapting simulation-pretrained operators to real-world data while retaining useful pretrained structure. The pretrained operator is first finetuned on real data and then frozen to provide a source prediction, and a shared repair module learns a sequence of refinements from the same observations. Using orthogonal Fourier projections, a spectral ensemble fits a small ridge regression within each cell of the Fourier domain and combines the refinements by weights fitted on a held-out split of the real data. The cells are defined jointly by radial ranges, angular sectors, and measured channels, allowing refinement depth to vary with frequency magnitude, with orientation, and across channels. item.title: 该研究提出用“预测未来哪些时段包含稀疏事件”的排序任务而非数值预测来评估时间序列基础模型，发现其点预测几乎不超过简单基线，而对冻结骨干网络训练线性探针在绝大多数情况下显著更优。
item.description:
何时，而非多少：在稀疏事件上评估时间序列基础模型

When, Not How Much: Evaluating Time-Series Foundation Models on Sparse Events

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39386

该研究提出用“预测未来哪些时段包含稀疏事件”的排序任务而非数值预测来评估时间序列基础模型，发现其点预测几乎不超过简单基线，而对冻结骨干网络训练线性探针在绝大多数情况下显著更优。

预训练时间序列基础模型（TSFM）通常被评估为未来数值的预测器，然而对于稀疏序列，许多决策仅取决于未来哪些时段包含活动，而标准基准并未对此进行评估。在五个稀疏数据集上，作者对预测窗口内同时包含事件和零值的位置进行排序。结果显示：12个已发布TSFM的点预测在机会校正平均精度上相比免训练参考基线最多仅提升0.031，且在机会校正AUC上，中位数TSFM在所有数据集上均低于这些基线。在事件监督下，六个冻结骨干网络的线性探针在30个骨干-数据集组合中有29个优于其骨干自身的点预测。对预测分位数取平均而非取中位数，可改善大多数预测中位数的TSFM的排名，并且在两个数据集上，此类最强输出可媲美探针。探针相对于原始上下文学习者的优势取决于具体数据集。

arXiv:2609.39386v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pretrained time-series foundation models (TSFMs) are evaluated as forecasters of future values, yet for sparse series many decisions depend only on which future periods contain activity. Standard benchmarks do not assess this. On five sparse datasets, we rank positions within forecast windows that contain both events and zeros. The released point forecasts of 12 TSFMs improve chance-corrected average precision over training-free references by at most 0.031, and in chance-corrected AUC the median TSFM falls below them on every dataset. With event supervision, linear probes of six frozen backbones improve on their backbone's point forecast in 29 of 30 backbone--dataset pairs. Averaging the predicted quantiles instead of taking their median improves the ranking of most TSFMs that forecast the median, and on two datasets the strongest such outputs rival the probes. item.title: 本文提出STAR-Ar，一种融合上下文Transformer嵌入与结构化转移约束的BERT-BiLSTM-CRF序列标注架构，用于阿拉伯语论辩话语单元的检测与分类，在Daleel 2026共享任务的测试集上取得73.7的F1分数。
item.description:
TTLab参加Daleel 2026：STAR-Ar——用于阿拉伯语论辩识别的序列标注方法

TTLab at Daleel 2026: STAR-Ar, Sequence Tagging for Argument Recognition in Arabic

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39385

本文提出STAR-Ar，一种融合上下文Transformer嵌入与结构化转移约束的BERT-BiLSTM-CRF序列标注架构，用于阿拉伯语论辩话语单元的检测与分类，在Daleel 2026共享任务的测试集上取得73.7的F1分数。

论辩挖掘（AM）是自然语言处理中的一项关键任务，但在阿拉伯语中资源严重不足。本文提出了STAR-Ar，一种用于论辩话语检测与分类的BERT-BiLSTM-CRF架构，作为我们参加Daleel 2026——首届阿拉伯语论辩挖掘共享任务——的系统。该任务要求在辩论和社论文本中识别并分类论辩话语单元（ADU）。我们将这两个目标联合建模为词元级的序列标注任务，所采用的BERT-BiLSTM-CRF架构将上下文Transformer嵌入与结构化转移约束相结合，以支持准确的跨度检测。STAR-Ar在验证集上取得了72.69的F1分数，在测试集上取得了73.7的F1分数。我们的领域特定分析表明，仅在社论上训练的模型表现不及在辩论数据上训练的模型，我们主要将这一差距归因于社论数据的规模较小。

arXiv:2609.39385v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Argument Mining (AM) is a critical NLP task that remains significantly under-resourced in Arabic. This paper presents $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$, a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF architecture for argument discourse detection and classification, as our system for Daleel 2026, the inaugural Arabic argument mining shared task. The task requires the identification and classification of argumentative discourse units (ADUs) in debate and editorial texts.We jointly model these two objectives as a token-level sequence labeling task using a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF architecture that combines contextual transformer embeddings with structural transition constraints to support accurate span detection. $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$ achieves an F1-score of 72.69 on validation and 73.7 on test data. Our domain-specific analysis shows that models trained exclusively on editorials underperform those trained on debates, a disparity we primarily attribute to the smaller size of the editorial data

item.title: 该论文首次将自动启发式设计（AHD）中小型开源LLM的在线后训练形式化为一个上下文相关的学习问题，指出被评估候选流同时驱动搜索状态更新与模型训练，并强调将评估结果转化为学习信号时必须结合产生候选的提示词与不断演化的搜索状态。
item.description:
从搜索到信号：自动启发式设计中的在线后训练

From Search to Signal: Online Post-Training in Automatic Heuristic Design

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39383

该论文首次将自动启发式设计（AHD）中小型开源LLM的在线后训练形式化为一个上下文相关的学习问题，指出被评估候选流同时驱动搜索状态更新与模型训练，并强调将评估结果转化为学习信号时必须结合产生候选的提示词与不断演化的搜索状态。

基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动启发式设计（AHD）通过迭代方式提出并改进启发式方法，将设计原理与可执行代码配对。任务特定的评估器对程序进行评估；执行结果和性能分数指导搜索过程。许多AHD系统保持生成器冻结不变；而EvoTune和算法与语言模型协同进化（CALM）则从评估后的候选中更新生成器。当这些结果驱动带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）时，便形成了一个与搜索耦合的循环：被评估的候选流既提供搜索状态的更新，又为生成未来候选的模型提供训练信号。然而，有效性和性能并不能唯一确定有用的模型更新；将它们转化为学习信号时，必须考虑产生每个候选的提示词以及不断演化的搜索状态。我们将AHD中小型开源权重LLM的在线后训练表述为上下文相关的序列生成问题（摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2609.39383v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based automatic heuristic design (AHD) iteratively proposes and refines heuristics, pairing design rationales with executable code. Task-specific evaluators assess programs; execution outcomes and performance scores guide search. Many AHD systems keep the generator frozen; EvoTune and Co-Evolution of Algorithms and Language Model (CALM) instead update it from evaluated candidates. When such outcomes drive reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), they create a search-coupled loop: the evaluated candidate stream supplies both search-state updates and training signals for the model that generates future candidates. Yet validity and performance do not uniquely determine useful model updates; converting them into learning signals must account for the prompt and evolving search state that produced each candidate. item.title: 该论文提出在小波域中进行流匹配的多元时间序列生成方法，利用多级离散小波系数天然不同的方差实现隐式的从粗到细生成过程，并配合通道标记Transformer直接建模跨通道依赖，在七个基准数据集上取得了最佳或持平的表现。
item.description:
面向时间序列的小波流匹配

Wavelet Flow Matching for Time Series

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39374

该论文提出在小波域中进行流匹配的多元时间序列生成方法，利用多级离散小波系数天然不同的方差实现隐式的从粗到细生成过程，并配合通道标记Transformer直接建模跨通道依赖，在七个基准数据集上取得了最佳或持平的表现。

合成时间序列越来越多地被用于数据增强、隐私保护的数据共享以及下游模型开发，然而如何忠实地再现多尺度时间结构与跨通道依赖关系仍然是一个挑战。我们研究了在小波域中通过流匹配进行多元时间序列生成的方法。通过在多级离散小波系数上进行操作，而非直接在时域中建模，该模型能够在不同尺度上分别表示粗粒度结构和逐渐精细的细节。这些系数天然不同的方差进一步诱导出一种隐式的从粗到细的生成过程，无需显式的多尺度调度。由于小波变换独立作用于每个通道，我们将其与通道标记Transformer相结合，利用其注意力机制直接建模跨通道依赖关系。在七个基准数据集和四种序列长度的实验中，我们的方法在大多数数据集-指标组合上表现最佳或持平。

arXiv:2609.39374v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Synthetic time series are increasingly used for data augmentation, privacy-preserving data sharing, and downstream model development, yet faithfully reproducing both multi-scale temporal structure and cross-channel dependencies remains challenging. We study multivariate time-series generation through flow matching in the wavelet domain. By operating on multilevel discrete wavelet coefficients rather than directly in the time domain, the model represents coarse structure and progressively finer details at separate scales. Their naturally different variances further induce an implicit coarse-to-fine generative process without requiring an explicit multi-scale schedule. Since the transform acts independently on each channel, we pair it with a channel-token transformer whose attention directly models cross-channel dependencies. Across seven benchmark datasets and four sequence lengths, our method is best or tied on a majority of dataset-me

item.title: 提出了EHR-RobustGym——一个基于MIMIC-IV构建、包含5,486对干净-噪声数据对的可扩展交互式环境，用于评估并训练能在噪声电子健康记录下保持鲁棒临床推理的智能体。
item.description:
EHR-RobustGym：面向鲁棒临床推理的智能体基准测试与训练环境

EHR-RobustGym: Benchmarking and Training Agents for Robust Clinical Reasoning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39371

提出了EHR-RobustGym——一个基于MIMIC-IV构建、包含5,486对干净-噪声数据对的可扩展交互式环境，用于评估并训练能在噪声电子健康记录下保持鲁棒临床推理的智能体。

在医院工作流程中，电子健康记录（EHR）通常充满噪声，且可能不包含确认临床查询中所引用事件或测量值所需的证据。即使数据库检索成功，临床智能体也可能忽视这些差异，返回看似合理但缺乏依据支持的答案。我们提出了EHR-RobustGym，这是一个可扩展的交互式环境，用于评估和训练基于噪声EHR的鲁棒临床智能体。EHR-RobustGym建立在MIMIC-IV医院记录之上（涵盖365,000名患者、31张数据表、超过5亿条记录），包含5,486对“干净-噪声”数据对，涵盖六种临床意图以及患者层面和人群层面的查询。这些数据对用于测试智能体对记录级、值级和查询级噪声的鲁棒性，同时交互式SQL/Python执行与结果验证机制支持轨迹数据的收集和训练。对多个大语言模型的评估揭示了显著的鲁棒性差距：智能体的平均任务成功率在……

arXiv:2609.39371v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In hospital workflows, electronic health records (EHRs) are often noisy, and may not contain the evidence needed to confirm events or measurements referenced in a clinical query. Even when database retrieval succeeds, clinical agents can overlook such discrepancies and return plausible but unsupported answers. We introduce EHR-RobustGym, a scalable and interactive environment for evaluating and training robust clinical agents grounded in noisy EHRs. The pairs test robustness to Record-level, Value-level, and Query-level noise, while interactive SQL/Python execution and outcome verification support trajectory collection and training. item.title: 该论文在师生模型中建立了持续学习下LoRA的精确动力学理论，揭示低秩更新虽能减少对已学任务特征的干扰从而缓解灾难性遗忘，但其初始化会减慢对新任务的适应。
item.description:
持续学习中LoRA的动力学理论

A Dynamical Theory of LoRA in Continual Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39367

该论文在师生模型中建立了持续学习下LoRA的精确动力学理论，揭示低秩更新虽能减少对已学任务特征的干扰从而缓解灾难性遗忘，但其初始化会减慢对新任务的适应。

尽管低秩适配被广泛使用，但人们对其在持续学习中的动力学行为，以及低秩更新影响灾难性遗忘的机制，仍然知之甚少。我们在一个可解的双任务师生模型中，为LoRA提供了渐近精确的动力学刻画。在高维在线学习极限下，我们针对有限个宏观序参量导出了一个封闭的常微分方程组，从而在整个初始任务1学习阶段以及随后在任务2上的LoRA微调过程中，都得到了泛化误差的精确表达式。该理论与有限维模拟定量吻合，并揭示了LoRA的两个特征效应：低秩适配减少了与任务1所学特征的干扰，但其初始化会减慢对任务2的适应。基于这一机理图景，我们进一步分析了一种状态相关的掩蔽方法……

We provide an asymptotically exact dynamical characterization of LoRA in a solvable two-task teacher-student model. In the high-dimensional online-learning limit, we derive a closed system of ordinary differential equations for a finite set of macroscopic order parameters, yielding exact expressions for the generalization errors throughout both the initial Task 1 learning phase and the subsequent LoRA fine-tuning on Task 2. The theory quantitatively matches finite-dimensional simulations and exposes two characteristic effects of LoRA: low-rank adaptation reduces interference with features learned on the first task, but its initialization slows adaptation to the second task. item.title: 提出LampAttention混合精度FlashAttention软硬件协同设计，以8位精度计算大多数注意力子块、自适应识别敏感子块并用16位重算，配合专用加速器规格，在不损失模型性能的前提下大幅提升注意力计算效率。
item.description:
LampAttention：面向专用加速器的前瞻混合精度FlashAttention

LampAttention: Look-Ahead Mixed-Precision FlashAttention for Dedicated Accelerators

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39361

提出LampAttention混合精度FlashAttention软硬件协同设计，以8位精度计算大多数注意力子块、自适应识别敏感子块并用16位重算，配合专用加速器规格，在不损失模型性能的前提下大幅提升注意力计算效率。

虽然大多数注意力logits可以在低精度下计算而不损害数值稳定性，但当前的注意力内核未能利用这一现象。我们提出了一种新颖的硬件-算法协同设计，即混合精度FlashAttention。我们的方法以8位格式累加键-查询乘积并计算其指数值，然后自适应地识别敏感子块并用16位格式重新计算。我们进一步提出了能够高效执行该流水线的专用加速器规格。基于Qwen3和Gemma 3的仿真实验表明，仅将少数被选择性地识别出的子块重新路由到高精度计算，就足以恢复基线模型的性能。

arXiv:2609.39361v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While most attention logits can be computed in low precision without degrading numerical stability, current attention kernels fail to exploit this phenomenon. We introduce a novel hardware-algorithm co-design in the form of mixed-precision FlashAttention. Our method accumulates key-query products and evaluates their exponentials in 8-bit formats, then adaptively identifies sensitive sub-blocks and recomputes them in 16-bit formats. We propose the specifications for a dedicated accelerator capable of executing this pipeline efficiently. Simulated experiments with Qwen3 and Gemma 3 show that rerouting a selective minority of sub-blocks to high precision is sufficient to recover the baseline model performance.

item.title: Galahad 通过为 vLLM、SGLang 和 llama.cpp 提供字节精确的记忆层（Taliesin 缓存并复用 KV 状态、Blaise 按需传递文档章节），避免对已读文本的重复计算，使 LLM 的阅读成为一次性成本，从而绕过每 token 算力上限的限制。
item.description:
绕过算力天花板：Galahad 中的字节精确记忆使 LLM 阅读成为一次性成本

Working Around the Compute Ceiling: Byte-Exact Memory in Galahad Makes LLM Reading a One-Time Cost LLM Reading a One-Time Cost

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39358

Galahad 通过为 vLLM、SGLang 和 llama.cpp 提供字节精确的记忆层（Taliesin 缓存并复用 KV 状态、Blaise 按需传递文档章节），避免对已读文本的重复计算，使 LLM 的阅读成为一次性成本，从而绕过每 token 算力上限的限制。

Transformer 语言模型在每个 token 上可执行的算力是有限的，Infosys 前首席执行官 Vishal Sikka 近期的研究认为，这一上限限制了模型能够执行或验证的任务范围（arXiv:2507.07505）。我们要问的是：在这一天花板之下的算力预算中，有多少被花费在模型已经完成过的工作上。推理服务在请求之间是无状态的：当模型针对同一份文档回答第二个问题时，它会从第一个 token 开始重新计算该文档的注意力状态。在七个真实世界数据集上，98.7% 的提示 token 都是模型已经读过的文本。我们提出了 Galahad——一个面向 vLLM、SGLang 和 llama.cpp 的记忆层，它使这种阅读成为一次性成本。Taliesin 为一段文本保存模型的键值（KV）状态，并在下一个包含相同字节的请求中直接加载，而无需重新计算。Blaise 则保存文档本身，仅将问题所需的章节传递给模型。在一个召回测试中……

arXiv:2609.39358v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A transformer language model performs a bounded amount of computation per token, and recent work by Vishal Sikka, former CEO of Infosys, argues that this bound limits which tasks a model can carry out or verify (arXiv:2507.07505). We ask how much of the budget beneath that ceiling is spent on work the model has already done. Serving is stateless across requests: a model that answers a second question about a document recomputes the document's attention state from the first token. On seven real-world datasets, 98.7% of prompt tokens were text the model had already read. We present Galahad, a memory layer for vLLM, SGLang and llama.cpp that makes this reading a one-time cost. Taliesin saves the model's key-value (KV) state for a block of text and loads it on the next request that contains the same bytes, instead of recomputing it. item.title: 提出Throttle方法，通过对较快客户端的梯度更新进行指数级软降权，将异步SGD泛化为兼具速度优势与拜占庭鲁棒性的统一框架，且在无攻击场景下同样能提升性能。
item.description:
通过软节流增强异步SGD的鲁棒性

Robustifying Asynchronous SGD via Soft Throttling

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39357

提出Throttle方法，通过对较快客户端的梯度更新进行指数级软降权，将异步SGD泛化为兼具速度优势与拜占庭鲁棒性的统一框架，且在无攻击场景下同样能提升性能。

异步SGD是分布式学习中一种流行的算法，其中每个客户端的梯度更新在到达时即被应用。这带来了速度提升，但也增加了对攻击的脆弱性，因为速度快的客户端可能会主导整体更新。我们提出了Throttle，一种具有拜占庭鲁棒性的异步SGD泛化方法，其核心思想是通过因子 $q$ 对来自较快客户端的更新进行指数级降权。异步SGD（$q=1$）和同步拜占庭鲁棒SGD（$q\to\infty$）都是Throttle在特定设置下的特例。我们对收敛速度进行了理论分析，并从理论和实验两方面验证了该方法对攻击的鲁棒性。值得注意的是，我们的实验表明，这种降权机制即使在非拜占庭设置下也能超越标准异步SGD的性能。

arXiv:2609.39357v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Asynchronous SGD is a popular algorithm for distributed learning where each client's gradient update is applied on arrival. This leads to a speed-up, but also an increased vulnerability to attacks, as fast clients can dominate the total update. We introduce Throttle, a Byzantine-robust generalization of asynchronous SGD where the key idea is to exponentially down-weight updates from faster clients by a factor $q$. Both asynchronous SGD ($q=1$) and synchronous Byzantine-robust SGD ($q\to\infty$) correspond to specific settings of Throttle. We provide a theoretical analysis of the convergence rate and validate the robustness to attacks both theoretically and empirically. Remarkably, our experiments show that this down-weighting mechanism can also improve performance over standard asynchronous SGD even in the non-Byzantine setting.

item.title: 该论文提出“局部敏感逃逸维度”这一新型复杂度度量，用于分析具有一般奖励函数类的基于偏好的老虎机问题，克服了逻辑斯蒂常数 $\kappa$ 带来的挑战以及以往工作仅限于线性或核化模型的局限。
item.description:
基于偏好的老虎机问题的复杂度研究

On the Complexity of Preference-Based Bandits

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39351

该论文提出“局部敏感逃逸维度”这一新型复杂度度量，用于分析具有一般奖励函数类的基于偏好的老虎机问题，克服了逻辑斯蒂常数 $\kappa$ 带来的挑战以及以往工作仅限于线性或核化模型的局限。

我们研究了具有一般奖励函数类的基于偏好的老虎机问题，其中学习者依次选择臂对，并观察由 Bradley--Terry 模型支配的二元偏好反馈。这一设定自然出现在推荐系统、锦标赛排名以及从人类反馈中学习等应用场景中，因为在这些场景下，相对偏好比绝对奖励更容易获取。该观测模型继承了逻辑斯蒂老虎机中处理依赖于问题的常数 $\kappa$ 的挑战，该常数反映了链接函数的非线性，并且可以任意增大。此外，先前的工作主要集中于线性或核化的奖励模型，无法使用更丰富的函数类。为了解决这些局限性，我们考虑一般的奖励函数类，并引入了“局部敏感逃逸维度”，这是一种专为偏好反馈的逻辑斯蒂结构设计的新型复杂度度量。

arXiv:2609.39351v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study preference-based bandits with general reward function classes, where a learner sequentially selects pairs of arms and observes binary preference feedback governed by the Bradley--Terry model. This setting naturally arises in applications such as recommender systems, tournament ranking, and learning from human feedback, where relative preferences are easier to elicit than absolute rewards. The observation model inherits the logistic bandit challenge of handling the problem-dependent constant $\kappa$, which accounts for the non-linearity of the link function and can grow arbitrarily large. Moreover, prior work has predominantly focused on linear or kernelized reward models, precluding the use of richer function classes. item.title: HAPMoE提出了一个异构感知的MoE自动并行规划框架，通过构建轻量级MoE感知成本模型并在六维并行空间中高效搜索，解决了MoE架构与异构集群挑战并存场景下的自动并行化难题。
item.description:
HAPMoE：面向混合专家模型训练的异构感知自动并行规划

HAPMoE: Heterogeneity-Aware Automatic Parallelism Planning for Mixture-of-Experts Models Training

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39350

HAPMoE提出了一个异构感知的MoE自动并行规划框架，通过构建轻量级MoE感知成本模型并在六维并行空间中高效搜索，解决了MoE架构与异构集群挑战并存场景下的自动并行化难题。

随着模型规模的持续扩大，分布式训练已变得不可避免。自动并行化技术能够以低成本推导出高效的训练并行策略，同时实现卓越性能。这一问题的难度由模型复杂度和底层计算集群共同决定。与此同时，混合专家模型日益成为主流架构，而加速器硬件的快速演进也使集群异构性变得普遍，这给自动并行化带来了巨大挑战。然而，现有方法通常只针对MoE架构或异构集群其中之一，无法泛化到两种挑战并存的场景。为此，我们提出了HAPMoE，一种面向MoE训练的异构感知自动并行规划器。HAPMoE构建了一个轻量级的MoE感知成本模型，并高效搜索六维并行空间……

arXiv:2609.39350v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As model sizes continue to scale, distributed training has become inevitable. Automatic parallelization techniques can derive efficient training parallelism strategies at low cost while achieving superior performance. The difficulty of this problem is jointly determined by the complexity of the model and the underlying compute cluster. Meanwhile, mixture-of-experts (MoE) models are increasingly emerging as the dominant architecture and the rapid evolution of accelerator hardware has made cluster heterogeneity commonplace, posing substantial challenges to automatic parallelization. However, existing approaches typically target either MoE architectures or heterogeneous clusters, failing to generalize to scenarios where both challenges coexist. item.description:
黄金路径假设：扩散缓存中的可复用调度

The Golden Path Hypothesis: Reusable Schedules in Diffusion Caching

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39343

本文提出“黄金路径假设”，并通过跨十种缓存方法、四个图像与视频模型及140万个调度的大规模实验证明：与提示无关的缓存调度可跨提示复用，其生成质量可与最佳提示特定调度相媲美。

扩散缓存通过在选定的去噪步骤中用缓存或预测的特征替代Transformer计算来加速生成。我们提出黄金路径假设（GPH）：在固定的推理条件下，与提示无关的缓存调度能够在各种提示上取得与最佳提示特定调度相当的最终输出质量。我们在十种缓存方法、四个图像和视频模型以及三种缓存比率下对GPH进行了研究。提示自适应方法会反复选择少数几种调度，而在新提示上复用其最常用的调度，其质量几乎可以达到与提示特定选择相当的水平。在四个样本上对140万个调度进行的穷举评估进一步识别出若干与提示无关的调度，它们在未见过的提示上仍具竞争力。为了解释这种迁移能力，我们分析了去噪轨迹和缓存误差的累积。潜在状态轨迹表现出相似的结构

arXiv:2609.39343v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffusion caching accelerates generation by replacing transformer computation with cached or predicted features at selected denoising steps. We introduce the Golden Path Hypothesis (GPH): under fixed inference conditions, prompt-independent cache schedules can achieve final-output quality comparable to the best prompt-specific schedules across prompts. We investigate the GPH across ten caching methods, four image and video models, and three cache ratios. Prompt-adaptive methods repeatedly select a small number of schedules, and reusing their most frequent schedules on new prompts closely matches the quality of prompt-specific choices. Exhaustive evaluation of 1.4 million schedules on four examples further identifies prompt-independent schedules that remain competitive on unseen prompts. item.title: 本文提出用“无法被计算能力受限的交易者构造荷兰赌套利”来定义和度量语言模型的“理解”程度，证明理解本质上是分级的、下一词元预测目标本身会导致跨问题形式的不一致，并据此提出将抗套利作为训练目标的Arbitr框架。
item.description:
理解即无套利：有界荷兰赌作为语言模型的理解定义与训练目标

Understanding as No-Arbitrage: Bounded Dutch Books as a Definition and Training Objective for Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39341

本文提出用“无法被计算能力受限的交易者构造荷兰赌套利”来定义和度量语言模型的“理解”程度，证明理解本质上是分级的、下一词元预测目标本身会导致跨问题形式的不一致，并据此提出将抗套利作为训练目标的Arbitr框架。

语言模型仅仅是在预测词元，还是真正理解它所说的话？我们通过“无套利”的视角对“理解”进行定义，使这一问题变得可度量。如果一个计算能力受限的交易者无法通过针对模型在逻辑相关命题上的概率进行下注而获取保证利润（即“荷兰赌”），那么该模型就在一定程度上理解了这个词表。我们建立了三个理论结果：第一，由于完全的逻辑一致性在计算上是不可解的，理解本质上是分等级的，而非绝对的。第二，我们证明标准下一词元预测的精确最优解在不同问题形式之间本质上是不一致的；缺陷在于训练目标本身，而非模型架构。第三，我们表明不确定性会沿着推理链可预测地累积，使无根据的过度自信本身就构成套利机会。为解决这一问题，我们引入了Arbitr，一种训练框架……

arXiv:2609.39341v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Does a language model merely predict tokens, or does it understand what it says? We make this question measurable by defining "understanding" through the lens of no-arbitrage. A model understands a vocabulary to a certain degree if a computationally bounded trader cannot extract guaranteed profit by betting against the model's probabilities on logically related claims (a "Dutch book"). We establish three theoretical results: first, because full logical coherence is computationally intractable, understanding is inherently graded, not absolute. Second, we prove that the exact optimum of standard next-token prediction is inherently incoherent across different question formats; the flaw lies in the training objective, not the architecture. Third, we show that uncertainty accumulates predictably along reasoning chains, making unjustified overconfidence an arbitrage opportunity in itself. item.title: 提出统一多性质预测模型ElectrolyteFM，通过独立学习性质特定表示、结合单独训练的专家池与路由机制捕获跨性质共享知识，解决了联合训练中跨性质干扰问题，实现电解液多种性质的更准确预测。
item.description:
ElectrolyteFM：通过跨性质知识学习统一电解液性质预测

ElectrolyteFM: Unifying Electrolyte Property Prediction through Cross-Property Knowledge Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39340

提出统一多性质预测模型ElectrolyteFM，通过独立学习性质特定表示、结合单独训练的专家池与路由机制捕获跨性质共享知识，解决了联合训练中跨性质干扰问题，实现电解液多种性质的更准确预测。

电解液配方设计需要平衡多种物理化学性质，然而现有模型往往仅关注有限的性质子集。孤立地学习每种性质可能会忽略可迁移的化学信息，而不加区分的知识共享则可能引入跨性质干扰。我们的有向迁移分析表明，联合学习两个性质预测任务相比单独训练可能提升也可能降低预测效果，且任务间存在不对称的迁移效应。我们提出了ElectrolyteFM，这是一个统一的多性质预测模型，通过有效识别和利用性质特定特征以及跨性质共享的知识，能够更准确地预测每种电解液的多种性质。更具体地说，ElectrolyteFM独立学习性质特定的表示，并通过单独训练的专家池捕获跨性质知识，再由路由器选择相关的共享知识……

arXiv:2609.39340v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrolyte formulation design requires balancing multiple physicochemical properties, yet existing models often focus on a limited subset. Learning each property in isolation can overlook transferable chemical information, whereas indiscriminate sharing can introduce cross-property interference. Our directed transfer analysis shows that jointly learning two property prediction tasks can improve or degrade prediction relative to separate training, with asymmetric transfer effects between the tasks. We propose ElectrolyteFM, a unified multi-property prediction model which can more accurately predict multiple properties of each electrolyte by effectively identifying and utilizing property-specific features and knowledge shared across properties. item.title: 该论文证明知识蒸馏中完全模仿与条件学习之间存在精确分离——当需保持学生对正确类别的判别优势时，完整的师生KL最小化会恰好被阻断，但教师在错误类别间的相对概率仍可完全学习，并由此刻画了任务保持型蒸馏的精确代价。
item.description:
超越完全模仿的学习：任务保持型知识蒸馏

Learning Beyond Full Imitation: Task-Preserving Knowledge Distillation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39338

该论文证明知识蒸馏中完全模仿与条件学习之间存在精确分离——当需保持学生对正确类别的判别优势时，完整的师生KL最小化会恰好被阻断，但教师在错误类别间的相对概率仍可完全学习，并由此刻画了任务保持型蒸馏的精确代价。

知识蒸馏通过鼓励学生匹配教师预测的类别概率来传递知识。这些概率不仅表达了对正确类别的置信度，也表达了各个错误备选类别之间的关系。然而，更接近的模仿并不必然产生更好的学生。学生可能已经比教师更敏锐地区分出正确类别，此时进一步的模仿反而要求学生交还其已获得的判别能力。我们的主要结果是完全模仿与条件学习之间的精确分离：当必须保持正确类别相对于每个备选类别的分数优势时，恰好在学生对每个错误类别所分配的概率都不超过教师的情况下，从教师到学生的完整KL散度最小化会被阻断。至关重要的是，教师在各个错误类别之间的相对概率仍然是完全可学习的。我们刻画了这种传递的精确代价：一个最小的增加量（c……[摘要在此处截断]）

arXiv:2609.39338v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Knowledge distillation transfers knowledge by encouraging a student to match a teacher's predicted class probabilities. These probabilities express not only confidence in the correct class, but also relations among incorrect alternatives. Yet closer imitation does not necessarily yield a better student. A student may already distinguish the correct class more sharply than its teacher, so further imitation can require giving back discrimination it has acquired. Our main result is an exact separation between full imitation and conditional learning. When the correct class's score advantage over each alternative must be preserved, full teacher-to-student KL minimization is blocked exactly when the student assigns no more probability than the teacher to every incorrect class. item.title: WinoTS 提出了一种基于小波时频增强的不变性自蒸馏预训练范式，专为时间序列设计，通过构建多尺度结构视图来避免模型容量被浪费在学习高频逐点噪声上。
item.description:
WinoTS：基于小波自蒸馏的时间序列模型

WinoTS: Wavelet-based Self-Distillation for Time Series Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39337

WinoTS 提出了一种基于小波时频增强的不变性自蒸馏预训练范式，专为时间序列设计，通过构建多尺度结构视图来避免模型容量被浪费在学习高频逐点噪声上。

时间序列模型的自监督预训练目前主要被下一个词预测和重建目标所主导。在连续值领域，这些范式常常将模型容量浪费在高频的逐点噪声上，从而牺牲了对不变结构的学习。尽管基于不变性的自蒸馏在计算机视觉领域已被证明极为有效，但其在时序数据上的应用在很大程度上仍未被充分探索。要有效地将此类方法适配到时间序列，需要精心设计的增强策略：诸如裁剪等空间操作可能会改变重复周期的时间或使信号失真，而基础的抖动扰动所能提供的变化有限。我们提出了 WinoTS（面向时间序列的基于小波的自蒸馏），这是一种专为时间信号设计的基于不变性的预训练范式。其核心在于，WinoTS 利用时频增强来构建多尺度结构视图，而无需 d……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.39337v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Self-supervised pre-training of time series models is currently dominated by next-token prediction and reconstruction objectives. In continuous-valued domains, these paradigms often waste model capacity on high-frequency, point-wise noise at the expense of learning invariant structure. While invariance-based self-distillation has proven highly effective in computer vision, its application to temporal data remains largely underexplored. Effectively adapting such methods to time series requires carefully designed augmentations: spatial operations like cropping can shift the timing of repeating cycles or distort the signal, while basic jittering may provide limited variation. We introduce Wavelet-based self-distillation for time series (WinoTS), an invariance-based pre-training paradigm designed specifically for temporal signals. item.title: 该研究基于学习理论界首次建立了每个训练领域所需样本量的判别准则，揭示了训练领域数量与每领域所需样本数之间的反线性缩放规律，为评估现有数据集的充分性和构建新数据集提供了理论指导。
item.description:
跨领域学习需要多少样本才足够？

How Many Samples Are Enough for Learning Across Domains?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39336

该研究基于学习理论界首次建立了每个训练领域所需样本量的判别准则，揭示了训练领域数量与每领域所需样本数之间的反线性缩放规律，为评估现有数据集的充分性和构建新数据集提供了理论指导。

理解学习的基本机制对于设计具有强泛化能力的系统至关重要。最近的研究表明，当每个领域包含足够多的数据样本时，增加训练领域的数量或扩大它们之间的分布偏移可以提升泛化性能。然而，数据样本在什么条件下可以被认为是充分的，这一问题仍未被探索。在这项工作中，我们通过基于所提出的学习界建立每个领域样本需求的判别准则来填补这一空白。这些准则不仅揭示了训练领域数量与每个领域所需样本数量之间的反线性缩放规律，还解释了数据充分性假设背后的基本原理，从而为评估现有数据集的充分性以及构建新数据集提供了理论指导。这与经典学习理论不同，因为

arXiv:2609.39336v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the fundamental mechanisms of learning is essential for designing systems with strong generalization. Recent studies have shown that increasing the number of training domains, or enlarging the distribution shift among them, improves generalization when each domain contains sufficiently many data samples. However, the conditions under which the data samples can be considered sufficient remain unexplored. In this work, we fill this gap by establishing criteria for per-domain sample requirements based on the presented learning bounds. These criteria not only reveal an inverse linear scaling law between the number of training domains and the number of samples required per domain, but also explain the fundamental rationale behind the assumption of data sufficiency, thereby providing theoretical guidance for assessing the adequacy of existing datasets and constructing datasets. item.title: PatchKV是一种无需训练的框架，通过岭回归以闭式解将上下文特定的权重补丁合并进模型权重，以补偿KV缓存压缩带来的信息损失，且不增加每次查询的推理成本。
item.description:
PatchKV：KV缓存的权重空间补偿

PatchKV: Weight-Space Compensation of KV Cache

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39329

PatchKV是一种无需训练的框架，通过岭回归以闭式解将上下文特定的权重补丁合并进模型权重，以补偿KV缓存压缩带来的信息损失，且不增加每次查询的推理成本。

在大语言模型（LLM）的长上下文推理中，键值（KV）缓存线性增长的内存是主要瓶颈。现有的压缩方法通过令牌驱逐或近似来缩减缓存，但在激进的压缩预算下性能会急剧下降。我们提出PatchKV，这是一个无需训练的框架，通过将部分上下文信息承载到模型权重中来补偿KV缓存压缩方法。PatchKV将现成的压缩KV缓存与一个上下文特定的权重补丁配对，该权重补丁在上下文加载时仅计算一次，并可服务于该上下文的所有下游查询。权重补丁通过岭回归以闭式解推导得出，具体做法是对齐完整缓存与压缩缓存下、由上下文生成的参考查询令牌的逐块激活。补丁一旦合并到模型中，便不再改变前向计算图，且在单上下文、多查询的设置下每次查询的推理成本保持不变。

arXiv:2609.39329v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-context inference with Large Language Models (LLMs) is bottlenecked by the linearly growing memory of the key-value (KV) cache. Existing compression methods reduce the cache through token eviction or approximation, but degrade sharply at aggressive compression budgets. We propose PatchKV, a training-free framework that compensates KV cache compression methods by carrying part of the context in the model's weights. PatchKV pairs an off-the-shelf compressed KV cache with a context-specific weight patch, which is computed once at context-loading time and served for downstream queries for the context. The weight patch is derived in closed form via ridge regression, by aligning the block-wise activations of context-derived reference query tokens under the full cache and the compressed cache. Once merged into the model, the patch leaves the forward graph and per-query inference cost unchanged in the single-context, multi-query setting. Ac

item.title: 该论文提出条件曲率分数（CCS）与对角线外曲率分数（OCS），将基于分数匹配的因果发现方法从连续数据推广到计数数据，并证明零CCS可精确刻画半参数广义线性模型的条件形式，从而实现从计数数据中恢复因果有向无环图。
item.description:
离散分数匹配使基于计数数据的因果发现成为可能

Discrete Score Matching Enables Causal Discovery from Count Data

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39326

该论文提出条件曲率分数（CCS）与对角线外曲率分数（OCS），将基于分数匹配的因果发现方法从连续数据推广到计数数据，并证明零CCS可精确刻画半参数广义线性模型的条件形式，从而实现从计数数据中恢复因果有向无环图。

计数数据对基于分数匹配的因果发现方法构成了挑战：导数不可用，而简单地用有限差分来替代导数通常不足以完成因果发现。我们通过以节点的取值为条件，推广了SCORE的常曲率准则（Rolland et al., 2022），得到了用于变量排序的条件曲率分数（CCS）。我们还通过对角线外曲率分数（OCS）扩展了基于曲率的父节点恢复方法，使得有向无环图（DAG）的恢复成为可能，这两种分数对于连续数据由分数函数构造，对于计数数据则由具体分数构造。在双变量情形下，零CCS精确刻画了一种半参数广义线性模型（GLM）条件形式，其中条件分布族无需事先指定，这与经典GLM不同。对于满足我们正则性条件的双变量半参数GLM DAG，规范参数的非线性是必要且充分的（原文此处截断）。

arXiv:2609.39326v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Count data pose a challenge for score-matching-based causal discovery: derivatives are unavailable, and simply replacing them with finite differences does not generally suffice for causal discovery. We generalize SCORE's constant-curvature criterion (Rolland et al., 2022) by conditioning on the node's value, yielding the conditional curvature score (CCS) for ordering. We also extend curvature-based parent recovery through the off-diagonal curvature score (OCS), enabling directed acyclic graph (DAG) recovery with both scores constructed from score functions for continuous data and concrete scores for counts. In the bivariate setting, zero CCS exactly characterizes a semiparametric generalized linear model (GLM) conditional form in which the conditional family need not be specified in advance, unlike in classical GLMs. For bivariate semiparametric GLM DAGs under our regularity condition, canonical-parameter nonlinearity is necessary and su

item.title: 该论文提出 MotionWeave 框架，通过动作诱导运动定位器（AIMG）和视界残差组合器（HRC）两个模块，以运动为中心建模未来动态，在动作时间步与局部视觉变化之间建立精确对应关系，从而提升视觉-语言-动作模型的动作块预测能力。
item.description:
MotionWeave：面向视觉-语言-动作策略的学习以运动为中心的未来动态

MotionWeave: Learning Motion-Centered Future Dynamics for Vision-Language-Action Policies

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39324

该论文提出 MotionWeave 框架，通过动作诱导运动定位器（AIMG）和视界残差组合器（HRC）两个模块，以运动为中心建模未来动态，在动作时间步与局部视觉变化之间建立精确对应关系，从而提升视觉-语言-动作模型的动作块预测能力。

视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型最近引入了世界模型，以提供超越稀疏动作标签的更丰富的动态监督。然而，显式预测未来图像或视频可能包含与控制无关的外观信息，而由整体未来视觉表征和共享的全局动作特征所导出的引导，可能难以在动作与局部视觉变化之间建立特定时间步的对应关系。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 MotionWeave，一个以运动为中心的未来动态框架，用于动作块预测，包含两个模块：动作诱导运动定位器和视界残差组合器。具体而言，AIMG 以动作和本体感知表征为条件，构建针对各个视界时刻的查询，从当前视觉标记中定位与每个未来动作时间步相关联的交互区域。HRC 提取相邻时刻交互表征之间的差异……

arXiv:2609.39324v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently incorporated world models to provide richer dynamic supervision beyond sparse action labels. However, explicitly predicting future images or videos may include control-irrelevant appearance, while guidance derived from holistic future visual representations and shared global action features may fail to establish timestep-specific correspondence between actions and local visual changes. To address this issue, we propose MotionWeave, a motion-centric future-dynamics framework for action-chunk prediction with two modules: the Action-Induced Motion Grounder (AIMG) and the Horizon Residual Composer (HRC). Specifically, AIMG conditions on action and proprioceptive representations to construct horizon-specific queries that localize interaction regions associated with each future action timestep from current visual tokens. item.title: 本研究在单节点8xA100的实际算力约束下，系统性地研究了1.5B至7B参数小型语言模型的GRPO微调训练动态，涵盖数学、编程和科学选择题等多个推理领域，分析组大小对策略收敛、训练稳定性和下游性能的影响，并刻画张量级更新动态及LoRA目标模块选择的改进作用。
item.description:
面向小型语言模型的GRPO训练动态研究

GRPO Training Dynamics for Small Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39321

本研究在单节点8xA100的实际算力约束下，系统性地研究了1.5B至7B参数小型语言模型的GRPO微调训练动态，涵盖数学、编程和科学选择题等多个推理领域，分析组大小对策略收敛、训练稳定性和下游性能的影响，并刻画张量级更新动态及LoRA目标模块选择的改进作用。

组相对策略优化（GRPO）已成为一种面向推理密集型任务的高效内存强化微调（RFT）技术。然而，GRPO在小型语言模型（SLM）上的训练动态仍未被充分理解，这限制了它在开放和资源受限环境中被可靠采用和复现。在本工作中，我们在实际的单节点8xA100计算预算下，对参数量从1.5B到7B的小型语言模型的GRPO微调进行了系统性研究。我们的研究涵盖多个模型家族和推理领域，包括数学、编程以及科学领域的多项选择题（MCQ）。在这些设置中，我们分析了组大小如何影响策略收敛、训练稳定性和下游基准性能。我们进一步刻画了GRPO训练过程中的张量级更新动态，并研究了LoRA目标模块和层的选择能否改进……

arXiv:2609.39321v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has emerged as a memory-efficient reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) technique for reasoning-intensive tasks. How- ever, GRPO training dynamics on small language models (SLMs) remain poorly understood, limiting its reliable adoption and reproducibility in open and resource- constrained environments. In this work, we present a systematic study of GRPO fine-tuning for SLMs ranging from 1.5B to 7B parameters under a practical single- node 8xA100 compute budget. Our study spans multiple model families and reasoning domains, including mathematics, coding, and multiple-choice question answering (MCQ) in science. Across these settings, we analyze how group size affects policy convergence, training stability, and downstream benchmark per- formance. item.title: 该论文提出ReSAIL即插即用增强方法，通过选择性蒸馏特权信息影响最大的交互步骤并正则化学生模型以保留特权信息行为，有效解决了迭代式智能体自蒸馏过程中的性能崩溃问题。
item.description:
ReSAIL：缓解迭代式智能体自蒸馏中的崩溃现象

ReSAIL: Mitigating Collapse in Iterative Agent Self-Distillation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39306

该论文提出ReSAIL即插即用增强方法，通过选择性蒸馏特权信息影响最大的交互步骤并正则化学生模型以保留特权信息行为，有效解决了迭代式智能体自蒸馏过程中的性能崩溃问题。

迭代式自蒸馏使大语言模型（LLM）智能体能够从连续部署中学习，为递归自我改进（RSI）提供了一条路径。然而，我们对现有方法的实验显示，随着循环迭代，部署性能出现崩溃，而使用特权信息（PI）时的任务性能也在下降。我们通过优先选择信息丰富的交互步骤进行蒸馏，并在学生模型成为下一个教师模型时保留基于特权信息的行为，来解决这一崩溃问题。我们提出了面向迭代自蒸馏的保留与选择性增强方法（ReSAIL），这是一种针对基于特权信息的迭代自蒸馏的即插即用增强模块。ReSAIL 选择特权信息最能改变教师模型预测的交互步骤，并平衡各轨迹上由此产生的蒸馏损失。同时，它还将学生模型在选定和未选定步骤上基于特权信息的输出分布向冻结教师模型的分布进行正则化，以保留特权信息相关行为。

arXiv:2609.39306v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Iterative self-distillation enables LLM agents to learn from successive deployments, offering a path toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet our experiments with existing methods reveal a collapse in deployment performance across cycles, while task performance with privileged information (PI) also declines. We address this collapse by prioritizing informative interaction steps for distillation and preserving PI-conditioned behavior as the student becomes the next teacher. We introduce Retentive and Selective Augmentation for Iterative Self-Distillation (ReSAIL), a plug-in augmentation for iterative PI-based self-distillation. ReSAIL selects interaction steps where PI most strongly changes the teacher's predictions and balances the resulting distillation losses across trajectories. It also regularizes the student's PI-conditioned output distributions toward those of the frozen teacher at selected and unselected steps to preserve PI

item.title: 本文提出广义几何块近端线性化方法，通过允许用任意内积和一般容许度量构造块代理函数，突破了传统欧氏几何框架的局限，显著提升了多块非凸非光滑优化问题的求解效率。
item.description:
面向多块非凸非光滑优化的广义几何块近端线性化方法

Generalized Geometry Block Proximal Linearized Method for Multiblock Nonconvex and Nonsmooth Optimization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39301

本文提出广义几何块近端线性化方法，通过允许用任意内积和一般容许度量构造块代理函数，突破了传统欧氏几何框架的局限，显著提升了多块非凸非光滑优化问题的求解效率。

本文考虑了一类在众多应用中出现的多块非凸非光滑优化问题。现有方法在标准欧氏几何框架内构造近端线性化算子或其变体来求解此类问题，使得块变量的更新被迫依赖于标准内积及其诱导范数。然而，这种构造方式无法捕捉目标问题的几何结构，导致数值效率低下。为克服这些缺陷，我们提出了一种用于更新块变量的广义几何近端线性化算子，并基于该算子发展了广义几何块近端线性化方法。与现有的近端线性化算子相比，所提出的算子允许使用任意内积和一般容许度量来构造块代理函数，从而使GGBPL方法能够适应问题的内在几何结构（摘要至此被截断）。

arXiv:2609.39296v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Video semantic communication has attracted increasing attention as a promising approach to improving video transmission efficiency. However, most existing approaches rely on computationally intensive deep learning-based video encoders and decoders, which hinders their deployment in resource-constrained scenarios. To address this issue, we propose a lightweight semantic-aware joint source-channel optimization (SAJSCO) scheme that can be integrated into existing digital video communication systems as a plug-in module. arXiv:2609.39291v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed computational methods usually optimize parameters within a functional representation whose structure is fixed in advance. This work proposes a Physics-Informed Method of Group Data Handling (PI-GMDH), in which representations of coupled physical fields are progressively constructed during solution. Candidate functional directions are evaluated through the first variation of the complete physical and observational objective, introduced in packages, and followed by block-coordinate damped Gauss-Newton coefficient optimization. Under the tested configuration, adaptive PI-GMDH reached validation and held-out test losses of 5.299e-19 and 5.296e-19 with 204, 201, and 175 active functions for u, v, and p. item.description:
倾斜的碗并非滑坡：压缩循环模型

A Tilted Bowl Is Not a Slippery Slope: Compressing Looped Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39277

该研究推翻了循环模型压缩崩溃源于舍入误差累积的传统观点，揭示了误差只是移动了循环收敛点，据此实现了仅需单次无标签测量即可预测模型失败，并通过最后几轮8位权重循环使失败模型恢复性能。

循环模型通过多次应用同一权重块来进行推理，因此压缩该权重块可以在每一轮循环中节省内存流量。然而，压缩后的循环模型常常会崩溃，这种崩溃通常被归咎于随循环不断累积的舍入误差。在这项工作中，我们在来自五个系列的30多个模型上检验了这一说法，并惊讶地发现，该说法仅适用于永不收敛的循环。当循环收敛（稳定）时，固定的舍入误差并不会累积。它只是移动了循环收敛的位置，就像倾斜的碗会改变球最终静止的位置一样，只有当偏移量超过读取端所能容忍的范围时，答案才会丢失。这一图景使我们能够通过单次无标签测量来预测哪些模型会失败，并且解释了为什么失败的模型能够恢复：它们的循环仍然会收敛，因此只需在最后几轮循环中使用8位权重就能找回答案。受这些发现的启发，我们构建了一个控制器来停止……

arXiv:2609.39277v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Looped models reason by applying the same block of weights many times, so compressing that block saves memory traffic on every loop. Compressed looped models, however, often collapse, and the collapse is usually blamed on rounding error that accumulates from loop to loop. In this work we test that account on more than 30 models from five families and find, to our surprise, that it holds only for loops that never settle. When a loop settles, a fixed rounding error does not accumulate. It moves the point where the loop settles, much as tilting a bowl moves where a ball comes to rest, and the answer is lost only when the shift is larger than the readout tolerates. This picture lets us predict which models fail from a single label-free measurement, and it tells us why failed models recover: their loops still settle, so a few final loops with 8-bit weights bring the answer back. 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在学生模型自身生成的前缀上，利用教师模型的token级别反馈进行训练，但在每个token处传输或存储教师模型的完整词表分布代价高昂。熵感知OPD（EOPD）在反向KL散度基础上增加了前向监督，以帮助学生模型恢复其低估的合理token，并仅使用教师模型的top-k概率来限制成本。由于EOPD会对这些概率进行重新归一化，其目标分布对被省略的词表部分不分配任何概率质量。我们证明，即使学生模型已经在top-k集合内匹配了教师模型的相对概率，由此产生的损失仍会持续将学生模型的top-k概率质量推向1，因此只要被省略的token具有正的教师概率，教师模型本身就不是损失函数的驻点。我们提出ReTaCo（Residual-Target Control，残差目标控制），该方法单独保留top-k token，并将其余token归并为一个残差符号，同时将此fo……

arXiv:2609.39275v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generated prefixes with token-level teacher feedback, but transmitting or storing the teacher's full-vocabulary distribution at every token is costly. Entropy-aware OPD (EOPD) adds forward supervision to reverse KL to help the student recover plausible tokens it underestimates, using only the teacher's top-$k$ probabilities to limit cost. Because EOPD renormalizes these probabilities, its target assigns no mass to the omitted vocabulary. We prove that the resulting loss keeps pushing the student's top-$k$ mass toward one even after the student matches the teacher's relative probabilities within the top-$k$ set, so the teacher itself is not a stationary point whenever the omitted tokens have positive teacher probability. 提出RW-Flow框架，通过Wasserstein梯度流在紧致流形上实现一步生成模型，并建立了流形上可识别性的充要条件，从而免去扩散模型所需的大量顺序网络评估。

流形取值的数据及其所诱导的分布在众多领域中普遍存在，从地震等地理空间事件的位置，到编码三维结构信息的生物分子扭转角。尽管扩散模型和基于流的生成模型已被成功扩展至紧致流形，但其采样通常需要数十甚至数百次顺序网络评估。我们提出RW-Flow，这是一个理论扎实的框架，通过Wasserstein梯度流在紧致流形上学习一步生成模型。其主要挑战在于可识别性：将速度场驱动至零时，应能保证模型分布与目标分布相匹配。我们在紧致连通黎曼流形上建立了可识别性的充要条件，并特别证明了：对于对称且满足Lipschitz连续性的代价函数，速度场……

arXiv:2609.39271v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Manifold-valued data, and consequently the distributions they induce, are prevalent across many domains, ranging from the locations of geospatial events, such as earthquakes, to biomolecular torsion angles that encode information about three-dimensional structure. While diffusion and flow-based generative models have been successfully extended to compact manifolds, sampling typically requires tens or hundreds of sequential network evaluations. We introduce RW-Flow, a theoretically grounded framework for learning one-step generative models on compact manifolds via Wasserstein gradient flows. The main challenge is identifiability: driving the velocity field to zero should guarantee that the model distribution matches the target distribution. We establish a necessary and sufficient condition for identifiability on compact, connected Riemannian manifolds. item.description:
面向可解释不规则时间序列分类的时间感知感受野袋方法

A Time-Aware Bag-of-Receptive-Fields for Interpretable Irregular Time Series Classification

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39268

该论文提出了一种时间加权归一化方案，将快速、确定性且可解释的感受野袋（BORF）变换扩展到不规则时间序列分类，使模式提取能够感知样本的实际时间分布而无需依赖插补或复杂的神经架构。

不规则时间序列以非均匀采样间隔、缺失观测值和可变长度为特征，在医疗健康、移动出行和环境监测等领域无处不在，然而针对这种场景的有效且可解释的分类器仍然有限。现有方法通常依赖插补技术，这可能掩盖数据的时间结构，或者需要复杂且不透明、难以解释的神经架构。在这项工作中，我们将感受野袋（BORF）——一种快速、确定性且可解释的时间序列变换——扩展到不规则时间序列场景。我们的关键贡献是一种时间加权归一化方案，其中每个观测值按其对应的时间增量成比例地加权，使模式提取对样本的实际时间分布敏感，而不仅仅依赖于其索引位置。这需要推导出针对时间加权统计量的高效滑动窗口递推公式。

arXiv:2609.39268v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Irregular time series, characterized by non-uniform sampling intervals, missing observations, and variable lengths, are ubiquitous in healthcare, mobility, and environmental monitoring, yet effective and interpretable classifiers for this setting are limited. Existing approaches often rely on imputation, which can obscure the temporal structure of the data, or require complex neural architectures that are opaque and difficult to explain. In this work, we extend the Bag-Of-Receptive-Fields (BORF), a fast, deterministic, and interpretable transform for time series, to the irregular setting. Our key contribution is a time-weighted normalization scheme in which each observation is weighted proportionally to its associated time delta, making pattern extraction sensitive to the actual temporal distribution of samples rather than only their index position. 该论文提出了一种仅需模型权重的几何诊断方法，通过测量概念子空间与unembedding矩阵主导右奇异方向的重叠度，发现概念表示（如FARS）仅携带极少读出方向能量，证明其位于输出读出的上游，超越了Logit透镜所能解释的范围。

概念子空间对模型行为的影响并不能确定它与输出读出之间的关系。我们引入了一种双向几何诊断方法，用于衡量提取出的子空间与unembedding矩阵主导右奇异方向的重叠程度，并以面向输出的阳性对照作为评估基准。给定一个提取出的基，该原始诊断仅需要模型权重即可完成。我们的测试平台是格式无关推理子空间（FARS），这是一个从以六种表面形式表达的十八个推理概念中提取出的十维基。在九个秩匹配的估计器和二十六个模型上，四个由激活导出的概念估计器在前十个读出方向跨度中的平均能量仅占0.38–0.80%。最后一层PCA携带3.56%的能量，在26个模型中的25个上超过FARS。一个通过拟合线性转换器进行深度匹配的同层下一词控制所携带的能量约为FARS的十三倍，且分离（摘要在此处截断）

item.description:
决策聚焦学习中的雅可比秩坍缩

Jacobian Rank Collapse in Decision-Focused Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39261

本文揭示了决策聚焦学习中的雅可比秩坍缩现象——当预测器雅可比矩阵为秩一时，逐样本梯度趋于共线，不同损失无法提供独立的参数更新方向，实验表明此时DFL相对MSE的性能提升十分有限。

决策聚焦学习（DFL）通过下游目标来训练预测器，但不同的损失函数未必能提供独立的参数更新方向。我们通过预测器的雅可比矩阵来刻画这一限制，并以稀疏指数跟踪问题为例，区分优化器所读取的协方差条目与学习过程可用的参数方向。秩一雅可比矩阵会使非零的逐样本梯度共线，而条件谱界则刻画了近乎共线的情形。批次子空间表征与反例说明，为何这些局部性论断既不意味着存在共同的极小值点，也不意味着批次更新必然共线。实验考察了这种几何结构何时会转化为决策质量：在38个单参数股票配置中，DFL相对于MSE的提升始终低于1.8%；一个385参数的条件预测器同样具有逐点秩一的特性。在经验证集调优的最短路径和背包实验中，全容量的SPO+……（原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.39261v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Decision-focused learning (DFL) trains predictors through downstream objectives, but a different loss need not provide an independent parameter-update direction. We characterize this restriction through the predictor Jacobian, using sparse index tracking to distinguish the covariance entries read by the optimizer from the parameter directions available to learning. Rank-one Jacobians make nonzero per-example gradients collinear; a conditional spectral bound describes near-collinearity. A batch-subspace characterization and counterexamples show why these local statements imply neither common minimizers nor collinear batch updates. Experiments examine when geometry translates into decision quality. item.title: 该论文提出条件函数可替代性（CFS）框架，将神经冗余性刻画为依赖输入的动态功能替代关系，发现性能提升与可替代性增长并不同步，且具有更独立功能结构的固定容量模型表现更好。
item.description:
有效并不意味着有用：面向Transformer冗余性与规模化的条件函数可替代性

Effective Does Not Mean Useful: Conditional Functional Substitutability for Redundancy and Scaling in Transformers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39259

该论文提出条件函数可替代性（CFS）框架，将神经冗余性刻画为依赖输入的动态功能替代关系，发现性能提升与可替代性增长并不同步，且具有更独立功能结构的固定容量模型表现更好。

现代神经网络的可扩展性具有可预测性，但这些规律背后的机制仍不清楚。神经冗余性通常通过组件重要性或表征相似性来刻画，而这两者都是间接的代理指标。我们将冗余性视为一种依赖输入的动态关系：当中间计算状态引发相似的下游响应时，它们在功能上是冗余的。我们提出条件函数可替代性来直接刻画这种功能替代。CFS揭示了传统基于重要性和相似性的度量所遗漏的功能关系与约减潜力。跨模态和Transformer家族的实验表明，CFS揭示了随规模变化而出现的系统性功能重组。受控规模扩展实验进一步表明，性能提升并不必然伴随可替代性的增长，而具有更独立功能结构的固定容量模型表现更好，为功能……

arXiv:2609.39259v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern neural networks scale predictably, yet the mechanisms behind these regularities remain unclear. Neural redundancy is typically characterized by component importance or representational similarity, both indirect proxies. We view redundancy as an input-conditioned, dynamic relation: intermediate computational states are functionally redundant when they induce similar downstream responses. We introduce Conditional Functional Substitutability (CFS) to directly characterize such functional substitution. CFS exposes functional relations and reduction potential missed by conventional importance- and similarity-based measures. Across modalities and Transformer families, CFS reveals systematic functional reorganization with scale. item.title: 本文提出TAMIS——一个可扩展、可解释的异常检测系统，通过识别每日电力生产时间序列与历史模式的偏差，自动检测EDF短期生产预测中的异常日期，并支持人在环路的工作流程。
item.description:
从基准测试到生产环境：将时间序列异常检测方法迁移至电力生产监控

From Benchmarks to Production: Transferring Time Series Anomaly Detection Methods for Electricity Production Monitoring

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39257

本文提出TAMIS——一个可扩展、可解释的异常检测系统，通过识别每日电力生产时间序列与历史模式的偏差，自动检测EDF短期生产预测中的异常日期，并支持人在环路的工作流程。

电力的准确预测对于维持能源公用事业的运营效率和战略规划至关重要。在工业环境中，此类预测每天生成，以确保供需平衡和生产资产的最优管理。然而，现代电力系统和数据流的日益复杂，给确保这些预测的可靠性和一致性带来了重大挑战。本文研究了EDF（法国电力集团）短期生产预测中的异常检测问题，将其定义为识别可能预示数据质量问题或运营异常的非典型日内模式。我们提出了TAMIS，这是一个可扩展且可解释的系统，通过分析与从历史数据中学习到的模式的偏差，对每日生产时间序列进行自动检测异常日期。TAMIS专为人在环路的工作流程设计，可呈现排名最高的异常……

arXiv:2609.39257v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Accurate forecasting of electricity production is essential for maintaining the operational efficiency and strategic planning of energy utilities. In industrial settings, such forecasts are generated daily to ensure supply-demand balance and optimal management of production assets. However, the increasing complexity of modern power systems and data flows poses significant challenges for ensuring the reliability and consistency of these forecasts. This paper addresses the problem of anomaly detection in short-term production forecasts at EDF, formulated as identifying atypical intra-day patterns that may signal data quality issues or operational irregularities. We introduce TAMIS, a scalable and interpretable system that analyzes daily production time series to automatically detect anomalous days based on deviations from historical patterns learned from past data. item.title: 该论文提出了一种客户端与训练数据联合选择算法，解决了基于概率的客户端选择方法在非独立同分布数据且客户端数量较少时失效的问题，从而实现联邦学习模型的快速收敛。
item.description:
面向计算高效的同步联邦学习的客户端与训练数据选择

Client and Training Data Selection for Computationally Efficient Synchronized Federated Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39250

该论文提出了一种客户端与训练数据联合选择算法，解决了基于概率的客户端选择方法在非独立同分布数据且客户端数量较少时失效的问题，从而实现联邦学习模型的快速收敛。

联邦学习（FL）是一种有前景的机器学习范式，通过无需与云服务器共享原始数据即可进行学习，从而保护用户隐私。掉队客户端一直是联邦学习中的一大难题，因为它们会延迟本地模型的聚合，进而延缓全局模型的收敛。因此，需要一种机制来确保全局模型的快速收敛以及良好的联邦学习参与率。联邦学习中影响模型收敛的另一个问题是客户端之间数据的非独立同分布（non-iid）特性。先前基于概率客户端选择的方法在非独立同分布数据下表现不佳，尤其是在客户端数量较少的情况下。我们展示了此类方法失效的场景，并提出了一种用于实现联邦学习模型快速收敛的客户端-训练数据联合选择算法。我们在CIFAR-100数据集上的实验表明，联邦学习模型的收敛可以……

arXiv:2609.39250v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a promising paradigm of machine learning, which preserves user privacy by enabling learning without sharing raw data with a cloud server. Straggling clients have been a problem for FL as they introduce delays in aggregating the local models and hence, the convergence of the global model. Therefore, it is important to have a mechanism that ensures fast convergence of the global model as well as good FL participation rate. Another issue for the convergence of a model in FL is the non-independent and identically distributed (non-iid) data across the clients. Prior approaches based on probabilistic client selection do not work well under non-iid data especially when the number of clients is small. We show scenarios where such approaches fail and propose a joint client-training data selection algorithm for fast convergence of FL models. item.description:
更信任评论家模型

Trust the Critic More

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39247

提出带动作分块的演员-评论家方法 AC2，利用学习到的评论家对动作块末端状态打分，实现无需将轨迹回滚到终端奖励的细粒度信用分配。

标准的语言模型强化学习算法会将由终端奖励决定的相同优势值分配给长序列回滚（rollout）中的每一个 token。演员-评论家方法虽然可以提供更细粒度的信用分配，但学习到的评论家模型通常被认为在用强化学习训练大语言模型时过于不准确而不可信。在近期的工作中，即使存在评论家模型，它也仅被用于基线估计，因此每条轨迹都必须回滚到终端奖励为止。我们提出了带动作分块的演员-评论家方法，消除了将每条轨迹回滚到完成的需要。AC2 转而将信用分配给动作块：即过去轨迹前缀的短延续。学习到的评论家模型对每个动作块结束时所处的状态进行打分，使策略无需观察到终端奖励即可完成更新。我们通过三个设计选择使基于评论家的信用分配变得可靠。首先，我们引入了“局部就绪度”，它使用基于评论家的更新（摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2609.39247v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Standard language model RL algorithms credit every token of a long rollout with the same advantage determined by the terminal reward. Actor-critic methods can provide finer-grained credit assignment, but learned critics are generally considered too inaccurate to trust when training LLMs with RL. In recent works, even when a critic is present, it is used only for baseline estimation, so every trajectory must be rolled out to its terminal reward. We introduce Actor-Critic with Action Chunking (AC2) that removes the need to roll every trajectory to completion. AC2 instead assigns credit to action chunks: short continuations of prefixes of past trajectories. A learned critic scores the state reached at the end of each action chunk, allowing the policy to update without observing a terminal reward. item.title: 该论文通过在预训练语言模型中植入隐藏路径来检测因果干预是否通过错误机制产生正确答案，并发现现有的基于距离的检测方法（如最近邻和局部PCA距离）不足以识别这种有害分歧。
item.description:
正确答案，错误机制：检测因果干预中的有害分歧

Right Answer, Wrong Mechanism: Detecting Pernicious Divergence in Causal Interventions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39243

该论文通过在预训练语言模型中植入隐藏路径来检测因果干预是否通过错误机制产生正确答案，并发现现有的基于距离的检测方法（如最近邻和局部PCA距离）不足以识别这种有害分歧。

诸如激活修补和分布式对齐搜索（DAS）等因果干预是对神经网络做出机制性解释的主要工具。近期研究表明，这些干预通常会将表示推离模型的自然分布，而这种分歧有时无害，有时有害：它可能调用模型在自然输入上从不使用的路径，从而使干预通过错误的机制产生预期的答案。目前尚无方法能够区分这两种情况。我们通过在预训练语言模型中植入隐藏路径，使这一问题变得可检验；这些路径在构造上对所有基准提示都是沉默的，因此哪些干预依赖于它们是确切已知的。在GPT-2 small上的72种配置和100,800次干预中，我们有三项发现。(i) 先前工作中使用的干预位置处的最近邻和局部PCA距离，得分低于…（摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2609.39243v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Causal interventions such as activation patching and distributed alignment search (DAS) are the main tool for making mechanistic claims about neural networks. Recent work showed that these interventions routinely push representations off the model's natural distribution, and that such divergence is sometimes harmless and sometimes pernicious: it can recruit pathways the model never uses on natural inputs, so that an intervention produces the expected answer through the wrong mechanism. No method currently tells the two cases apart. We make this question testable by planting hidden pathways inside pretrained language models; the pathways are silent on every benchmark prompt by construction, so which interventions depend on them is known exactly. item.title: 本文首次为之字形持续同调建立了可微性框架，通过将线性插值过滤值跨越阈值的实值时间赋予持续性图端点，在温和正则性条件下实现几乎处处可微，并在显式零测度集之外证明局部Lipschitz连续性，从而使标准随机次梯度收敛保证可应用于学习管线。
item.description:
基于线性插值的之字形持续同调可微性框架

A differentiability framework for zigzag persistent homology via linear interpolation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39242

本文首次为之字形持续同调建立了可微性框架，通过将线性插值过滤值跨越阈值的实值时间赋予持续性图端点，在温和正则性条件下实现几乎处处可微，并在显式零测度集之外证明局部Lipschitz连续性，从而使标准随机次梯度收敛保证可应用于学习管线。

持续同调可以被微分并纳入学习管线中，但对于之字形持续同调，目前尚不存在类似的框架，而在底层拓扑结构随时间非单调演化时，之字形持续同调是必需的。我们针对在固定复形上对随时间变化的过滤值进行阈值化所得到的单纯复形序列，开发了这样一个框架。通过为持续性图的端点分配线性插值过滤值越过阈值的实值时间，我们将过滤值的连续性传递到图上的点。这产生了所得持续性图值映射的平滑局部提升，在对过滤值参数化施加温和的正则性条件下，我们由此推导出几乎处处可微的微分。我们证明了在某个显式的零测度排除集之外具有局部Lipschitz连续性；因此标准的随机次梯度收敛保证……

arXiv:2609.39242v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Persistent homology can be differentiated and incorporated into learning pipelines, but no analogous framework exists for zigzag persistence, which is needed when the underlying topological structure evolves non-monotonically over time. We develop such a framework for sequences of simplicial complexes obtained by thresholding time-dependent filtering values on a fixed complex. By assigning persistence diagram endpoints the real-valued times at which linearly interpolated filtering values cross the threshold, we transfer the continuity of the filtering values to the diagram points. This yields smooth local lifts of the resulting persistence-diagram-valued map, from which we derive differentials almost everywhere under mild regularity conditions on the parametrization of the filtering values. item.title: 该研究在真实核电站数据集上将流式异常检测方法与最先进的在线TSAD模型进行对比，发现在线TSAD具有更高的一致性，且集成策略展现出很强的鲁棒性。
item.description:
流式异常检测在工业时间序列中发现了什么（以及漏掉了什么）

What Streaming Anomaly Detection Finds (and Misses) in Industrial Time Series

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39232

该研究在真实核电站数据集上将流式异常检测方法与最先进的在线TSAD模型进行对比，发现在线TSAD具有更高的一致性，且集成策略展现出很强的鲁棒性。

法国电力集团（EDF）依靠对其发电厂的持续监控，以便在异常发生的第一时间将其检测出来。鉴于在无监督环境下不存在普遍最优的流式方法，我们将流式方法与部署在真实核电站数据集上在线运行的最先进时间序列异常检测（TSAD）模型进行了比较。这项工作还评估了流式环境下的自动化异常检测。结果表明，在线TSAD具有更高的一致性，而集成策略则表现出很强的鲁棒性。

arXiv:2609.39232v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: EDF relies on continuous monitoring of its power plants to detect anomalies as soon as they occur. Given the absence of a universally optimal streaming method in unsupervised settings, we compare streaming methods with state-of-the-art TSAD models deployed online on a real nuclear power plant dataset. This work also evaluates Automated Anomaly Detection in a streaming context. Results show higher consistency for online TSAD and strong robustness from ensembling strategies.

item.title: 提出RAIM聚合方案，通过鲁棒的堆叠逻辑回归与可采纳性检验，将多个廉价的开放权重小模型聚合起来，在幻觉/忠实度检测任务上能以极低成本接近Claude Sonnet等前沿专有模型的判断水平。
item.description:
RAIM：面向幻觉检测的廉价模型鲁棒聚合方法

RAIM: Robust Aggregation of Inexpensive Models for Hallucination Detection

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39229

提出RAIM聚合方案，通过鲁棒的堆叠逻辑回归与可采纳性检验，将多个廉价的开放权重小模型聚合起来，在幻觉/忠实度检测任务上能以极低成本接近Claude Sonnet等前沿专有模型的判断水平。

忠实度的自动评估日益依赖由大语言模型担任裁判，然而最可靠的裁判是专有的前沿模型，其成本高昂且不适合高吞吐量的监控场景。我们研究能否将一组廉价的开放权重裁判模型（4–9B）聚合起来以替代前沿模型，这种替代会牺牲什么，以及何时值得进行这种替代。我们提出RAIM，这是一种对成员间相关误差具有鲁棒性的聚合方案，它将交叉拟合的堆叠逻辑回归与一种可采纳性检验相结合，该检验从成员模型自身的输出中读取信息，用以判断何时对成员进行聚合能够优于其中最佳的单个成员，并且仍能接近前沿裁判的水平。我们在八个忠实度基准上，使用来自互不相交模型系列的十个裁判模型对RAIM进行了实例化。与Claude Sonnet相比，该裁判组保留了其中位数93%的Cohen's κ，平衡准确率平均仅下降2.9个百分点；读

arXiv:2609.39229v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automatic evaluation of faithfulness increasingly relies on a large language model acting as a judge, yet the most reliable judges are proprietary frontier models, costly and ill-suited to high-throughput monitoring. We investigate whether a panel of cheap open-weight judges (4--9B) can be aggregated to stand in for a frontier one, what the substitution sacrifices, and when it is worth making. We propose RAIM, an aggregation scheme robust to the members' correlated errors, coupling a cross-fitted stacked logistic regression with an admissibility test that, read from the members' own outputs, identifies when aggregating them improves on their best member and stays within reach of the frontier judge. We instantiate RAIM with ten judges from disjoint families across eight faithfulness benchmarks. item.title: QATFactory是一个开源的部署对齐训练框架，通过在BF16矩阵乘法上模拟部署时量化，使大语言模型能够在缺乏原生低精度硬件支持的GPU上进行NVFP4等格式的量化感知蒸馏与强化学习训练，并能直接导出至vLLM和llama.cpp且不带来额外推理开销。
item.description:
QATFactory：一个面向大语言模型量化感知训练与蒸馏的多功能、部署对齐框架

QATFactory: A Versatile, Deployment-Aligned Framework for Quantization-aware Training and Distillation of LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39223

QATFactory是一个开源的部署对齐训练框架，通过在BF16矩阵乘法上模拟部署时量化，使大语言模型能够在缺乏原生低精度硬件支持的GPU上进行NVFP4等格式的量化感知蒸馏与强化学习训练，并能直接导出至vLLM和llama.cpp且不带来额外推理开销。

大语言模型（LLM）推理正日益向低精度方向发展，以充分发挥硬件加速器的吞吐能力，但激进的后训练量化（PTQ）可能会降低模型质量。我们提出了QATFactory，这是一个用于部署对齐的量化感知蒸馏（QAD）和强化学习（QARL）的开源框架。QATFactory在以BF16执行矩阵乘法的同时模拟部署时的量化，使模型能够适应量化噪声，而无需训练硬件原生支持目标格式；例如，它支持在缺乏FP4 Tensor Core的H100 GPU上进行NVFP4训练。该框架支持NVFP4、MXFP4以及llama.cpp的Q4_K格式；支持稠密模型和混合专家（MoE）模型；并支持全参数训练和基于LoRA的训练。它可以将检查点直接导出到vLLM和llama.cpp，无需额外的有损转换步骤，也不会增加推理开销。

arXiv:2609.39223v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly moving toward lower precision to realize the throughput of hardware accelerators, but aggressive post-training quantization (PTQ) can degrade model quality. We present QATFactory, an open-source framework for deployment-aligned quantization-aware distillation (QAD) and reinforcement learning (QARL). QATFactory simulates deployment-time quantization while performing matrix multiplications in BF16, allowing models to adapt to quantization noise without requiring training hardware that natively supports the target format; for example, it supports NVFP4 training on H100 GPUs, which lack FP4 Tensor Cores. The framework supports NVFP4, MXFP4, and llama.cpp's Q4_K format; dense and mixture-of-experts models; and both full-parameter and LoRA-based training. item.title: 提出推理状态传播（RSP）方法，通过为每个推理前缀建模二进制有效性状态及其“中断”与“修复”转换概率，将结果监督有效传播至中间推理状态的学习，从而减少对昂贵过程标注的依赖。

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39220

提出推理状态传播（RSP）方法，通过为每个推理前缀建模二进制有效性状态及其“中断”与“修复”转换概率，将结果监督有效传播至中间推理状态的学习，从而减少对昂贵过程标注的依赖。

过程奖励模型（PRMs）通过提供细粒度信号来评估中间推理状态，在测试时扩展和强化学习中展现出显著效果，但其训练严重依赖于昂贵的过程标注。缓解这种依赖的一个自然方式是利用可扩展的结果监督来补充有限的过程监督。然而，现有的PRMs通常独立地对推理前缀进行建模，缺乏有效利用最终结果来指导中间推理状态学习的显式机制。我们提出了推理状态传播（Reasoning State Propagation, RSP），用二进制有效性状态表示每个推理前缀，并对推理轨迹中相邻状态之间的转换进行建模。具体而言，RSP预测有效状态变为无效状态的“中断概率”，以及无效状态恢复为有效状态的“修复概率”。通过传播这些转换……

We introduce Reasoning State Propagation (RSP), which represents each reasoning prefix with a binary validity state and models transitions between successive states across the reasoning trajectory. item.description:
在流式世界中，你该原地不动吗？流数据异常检测的综合基准研究

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39215

本文首次开展大规模实验研究，在统一的流式评估基准下系统比较流式与静态时间序列异常检测方法，质疑流式方法在现实场景中是否真的优于静态方法。

时间序列异常检测（TSAD）越来越多地被部署在流式场景中，即数据按顺序到达且可能呈现非平稳性。因此，近期文献中的多项工作提出了依赖增量更新以随时间自适应的流式异常检测方法。然而，这些方法大多源于流式离群点检测文献，并在很大程度上忽视了时间序列异常的核心特性。此外，其实证评估通常基于多样性有限的合成数据或小规模基准，导致流式方法在真实的TSAD场景中是否真正具有优势尚不明确。在本工作中，我们开展了首个大规模实验研究，在统一的流式评估基准下比较流式与静态TSAD方法。我们考虑了一个贴近现实的设定：先有一批初始数据可用于模型训练，随后（数据以流式形式持续到达）……

arXiv:2609.39215v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) is increasingly deployed in streaming settings, where data arrive sequentially and may exhibit non-stationarity. As a result, several works from the recent literature propose streaming anomaly detection methods that rely on incremental updates to adapt over time. However, most of these approaches originate from the streaming outlier detection literature and largely ignore core characteristics of time series anomalies. Moreover, their empirical evaluation is typically conducted on synthetic or small-scale benchmarks with limited diversity, making it unclear whether streaming methods are truly advantageous in realistic TSAD scenarios. In this work, we carry out the first large-scale experimental study comparing streaming and static TSAD methods under a unified streaming evaluation benchmark. item.description:
未知相关设计下的极小极大可加回归

Minimax Additive Regression under Unknown Dependent Designs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39212

该论文研究了维度随样本量增长、设计分布可能非乘积且边缘密度未知情形下的可加回归问题，通过 Riesz 基构造与阈值化最小二乘估计，建立了已知或未知边缘密度下相互匹配的极小极大预测误差界，并揭示了密度正则性何时影响最优速率。

我们研究了在 $[0,1]^d$ 上可能非乘积的随机设计下的可加回归问题，并允许维度 $d$ 随样本量 $n$ 增长。我们引入了耦合的光滑性类，分别控制边缘密度的正则性和密度加权的可加分量。为处理变量间的相关性，我们针对函数型方差分析（ANOVA）模型采用了 Riesz 基构造，并在联合密度的一致界条件下，建立了常数与维度无关的相容性界。我们构造了阈值化最小二乘估计量，并在适当的维度增长条件下，针对已知或未知边缘密度的预测问题建立了相互匹配的极小极大上下界。当边缘密度的光滑性至少不低于加权分量时，未知密度情形可以达到已知密度情形的极小极大速率；当密度不够光滑时，其正则性决定了极小极大速率。

arXiv:2609.39212v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study additive regression under a potentially non-product random design on $[0,1]^d$, allowing the dimension $d$ to grow with the sample size $n$. We introduce coupled smoothness classes that separately control the regularity of the marginal densities and the density-weighted additive components. To handle dependence, we adapt a Riesz-basis construction for functional ANOVA models and establish compatibility bounds with constants independent of the dimension under uniform bounds on the joint density. We construct thresholded least-squares estimators and establish matching minimax upper and lower bounds for prediction with known or unknown marginal densities, under suitable dimension-growth conditions. When the marginal densities are at least as smooth as the weighted components, the unknown-density problem attains the known-density minimax rate. item.title: 提出重要性感知的类别均衡稀疏化方法（ICS），由服务器利用基于Grad-CAM的分数对特征通道排序并生成类别均衡的重要性向量，客户端复用该向量保留最重要的特征通道，从而在降低无线拆分学习通信开销的同时缓解标签偏斜带来的精度下降。
item.description:
面向无线拆分学习的重要性感知特征稀疏化

Importance-Aware Feature Sparsification for Wireless Split Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39194

提出重要性感知的类别均衡稀疏化方法（ICS），由服务器利用基于Grad-CAM的分数对特征通道排序并生成类别均衡的重要性向量，客户端复用该向量保留最重要的特征通道，从而在降低无线拆分学习通信开销的同时缓解标签偏斜带来的精度下降。

无线拆分学习（SL）通过将上层网络卸载到服务器来减少设备端的计算量，但在每次迭代中传输高维中间特征仍然是一个主要的通信瓶颈。现有方法在客户端使用与任务无关的准则（如幅值、统计量或聚类）来选择特征，这增加了客户端的处理负担，并且在非独立同分布的客户端数据下常常导致精度下降。我们提出重要性感知的类别均衡稀疏化，这是一种轻量级方法，由服务器在反向传播过程中利用基于Grad-CAM的分数（从真实类别的logit获得）对特征通道进行排序。各类别的分数被聚合为一个类别均衡、与标签无关的重要性向量，以缓解标签偏斜下的头部类别偏差，每个客户端在下一轮中复用该向量来保留前N个特征通道，且不产生额外的开销。

arXiv:2609.39194v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Wireless split learning (SL) reduces on-device computation by offloading upper layers to a server, yet transmitting high-dimensional intermediate features at each iteration remains a major communication bottleneck. Existing methods select features at the client side using task-agnostic criteria such as magnitude, statistics, or clustering, which increases client-side processing and often degrades accuracy under non-independent and identically distributed (non-i.i.d.) client data. We propose importance-aware class-balanced sparsification (ICS), a lightweight approach in which the server ranks feature channels using Grad-CAM-based scores obtained from the true-class logit during backpropagation. item.title: 该论文将深度分类器建模为有限非自治离散动力系统，通过有限时间最大李雅普诺夫指数（FTMLE）在数学上证明决策边界在概率、logits 直至隐藏表示各层面均留下可追溯的几何动力学特征。

从动力学到决策：深度分类器中李雅普诺夫谱与决策边界的数学理论

Dynamics to decision: A mathematical theory of Lyapunov spectra and decision boundaries in deep classifiers

arXiv:2609.39190v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A deep classifier is defined not only by the decision it produces, but also by the sequence of transformations through which that decision is formed. Treating this evolution as a dynamical system across layers provides a natural framework for asking how decision geometry emerges through depth and how far back we can trace a boundary's dynamical signature. We model a feed-forward classifier as a finite, nonautonomous discrete dynamical system, with layers playing the role of discrete time steps. We study the Finite-Time Maximum Lyapunov Exponent (FTMLE) of the data samples' dynamical trajectory through depths of the classifier. The FTMLE measures the rate of convergence/divergence of nearby trajectories. We move the observation endpoint backward from probabilities to logits and then to hidden representations. item.description:
注意力函数作为内在归纳偏置：模型行为如何在新颖情境中产生分歧

Attention Function as an Intrinsic Inductive Bias: How Models' Behavior Diverges in Novel Contexts

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39188

该论文提出MoFA（函数混合注意力），通过在训练前固定softmax与sigmoid注意力头的比例，将其作为Transformer的内在归纳偏置，并发现该比例在分布内影响微弱，但在零样本分布偏移下会显著影响模型行为。

发展心理学认为，某些先验是在经验之前就赋予婴儿的，而非从数据中归纳得出，并且这类先验的影响在强约束条件下会被抑制，但在弱约束条件下会重新显现。我们提出一个问题：类似的原则是否也适用于Transformer——赋予注意力头的激活函数能否作为一种内在归纳偏置？我们提出了函数混合注意力（Mixture of Function Attention, MoFA），这是一种对多头注意力的无参数修改方法，它在训练前固定softmax头与sigmoid头的比例。通过对五种比例、一个1.24亿参数的GPT-2模型和五个随机种子进行实验，我们发现这一预先给定的比例在分布内几乎没有影响——对于中等混合比例，各比例之间的差异在统计上可以忽略不计，即使在极端情况下差异也很小——但在跨越15个分布外领域的零样本分布偏移下，其影响会急剧重现。困惑度……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.39188v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Developmental psychology holds that certain priors are given to infants prior to experience rather than induced from data, and that the influence of such priors is suppressed under strong, well-constrained conditions but reasserts itself under weak ones. We ask whether an analogous principle holds for the Transformer: can the activation function given to attention heads serve as an intrinsic inductive bias? We propose Mixture of Function Attention (MoFA), a parameter-free modification to multi-head attention that fixes a ratio of softmax and sigmoid heads before training. Across five ratios, a 124M-parameter GPT-2 model, and five seeds, we find that this given ratio has little effect in-distribution -- differences between ratios are statistically negligible for moderate mixtures and remain small even at the extremes -- but its influence re-emerges sharply under zero-shot distribution shift across 15 out-of-distribution domains. item.title: 提出一种无需随机数的确定性黄金比例Weyl抖动方法，用于量化循环状态缓存的舍入操作，在长文本生成中始终比随机舍入更接近全精度模型且无额外开销。
item.description:
用于量化循环状态缓存的低差异性抖动

Low-Discrepancy Dither for Quantized Recurrent State Caches

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39185

提出一种无需随机数的确定性黄金比例Weyl抖动方法，用于量化循环状态缓存的舍入操作，在长文本生成中始终比随机舍入更接近全精度模型且无额外开销。

Mamba风格和混合语言模型将其历史信息压缩到一个固定大小的循环状态中，该状态在每个生成的token时都会被重写。以低精度存储该状态可以节省内存带宽，但每一次舍入误差都会被反馈到下一次更新中，并可能在长文本生成过程中不断累积。生产系统目前采用随机舍入的方式对该状态进行处理；我们探讨此类缓存究竟应该使用哪种舍入规则。我们发现，一种无需随机数的确定性黄金比例Weyl抖动方法，在纯模型和混合模型、各种存储格式以及长解码场景下，都能始终比随机舍入更好地使量化模型接近全精度模型，且不产生任何额外开销。最近舍入的行为则截然不同：由于它会丢弃微小的更新，其误差会持续增长，因此在短期评估中可能表现最佳，但在长文本生成中则远远落后。一项差异性分析解释了这种优劣排序，此外我们还记录了实现过程中的种种陷阱。

arXiv:2609.39185v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mamba-style and hybrid language models compress their past into a fixed-size recurrent state that is rewritten at every generated token. Storing this state in low precision saves memory bandwidth, but every rounding error is fed back into the next update and can accumulate over long generations. Production systems round the state stochastically; we ask which rounding rule such caches should use. We find that a deterministic golden-ratio Weyl dither, which needs no random numbers, consistently brings the quantized model closer to the full-precision one than stochastic rounding, across pure and hybrid models, storage formats, and long decoding horizons, at no extra cost. Round-to-nearest behaves differently: because it discards small updates, its error keeps growing, so it can look best in short evaluations yet falls far behind over long generations. item.description:
使用检测Transformer从多壳层扩散MRI进行纤维分辨的微结构定量分析

Fiber-Resolved Microstructure Quantification from Multi-Shell Diffusion MRI using Detection Transformers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39184

本文将扩散MRI微结构定量问题重构为目标检测类任务，首次采用DETR架构从标准线性编码的多壳层数据中联合预测每个体素可变数量区室的MD、FA、主纤维方向和信号分数，无需张量值扩散编码或代价高昂的逆拉普拉斯变换蒙特卡洛反演。

纤维取向和区室化微结构是扩散MRI中白质组织表征的核心，然而现有方法要么在不定量微结构的情况下解析纤维取向，要么在假设固定数量区室和单一纤维方向的前提下定量微结构。能够同时恢复两者的非参数方法需要张量值扩散编码，以及计算代价高昂的病态逆拉普拉斯变换的蒙特卡洛反演。我们提出将这一问题重新构建为类似目标检测的任务，采用检测Transformer（DETR）架构，从具有线性编码的标准多壳层扩散MRI中，联合预测每个体素中可变数量区室的平均扩散率（MD）、各向异性分数（FA）、主纤维方向和信号分数。训练过程中使用匈牙利匹配来解决区室之间的排列不变性问题。我们引入了m……

arXiv:2609.39184v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fiber orientation and compartmental microstructure are central to the characterization of white matter tissue in diffusion MRI, yet existing methods either resolve fiber orientations without quantifying microstructure, or quantify microstructure while assuming a fixed number of compartments and a single fiber direction. Nonparametric approaches that recover both require tensor-valued diffusion encoding and computationally expensive Monte-Carlo inversion of an ill-posed inverse Laplace transform. We propose to reframe this problem as an object detection-like task, adopting the Detection Transformer (DETR) architecture to jointly predict mean diffusivity (MD), fractional anisotropy (FA), main fiber direction, and signal fraction for a variable number of compartments per voxel from standard multi-shell diffusion MRI with linear encoding. item.title: 白化预处理通过均衡协方差矩阵的特征值，在无需先验知识或标注数据的情况下，减少线性探针对虚假相关性的依赖并提升鲁棒性。
item.description:
白化提升线性探针对虚假相关性的鲁棒性

Whitening Improves Robustness to Spurious Correlations in Linear Probes

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39177

白化预处理通过均衡协方差矩阵的特征值，在无需先验知识或标注数据的情况下，减少线性探针对虚假相关性的依赖并提升鲁棒性。

深度神经网络往往依赖于可能属于虚假特征的简单特征，从而导致泛化失败。我们在线性探针的设置下研究这一问题，即在（预训练）模型的表示上拟合（广义）线性模型。我们利用这些模型与最大间隔分类器之间的联系，证明它们偏好与协方差矩阵大特征值相关的方向。白化通过均衡协方差矩阵的特征值消除了这种偏好。这一观察启发了我们将白化作为一种预处理步骤，它可以在无需事先知道虚假相关性存在、也无需标注数据的情况下，减少对虚假相关性的依赖。我们在合成数据生成过程和标准虚假相关性基准上检验了白化的效果，发现它能够提升鲁棒性。我们还发现，将白化加入到现有方法中也能带来鲁棒性的提升。

arXiv:2609.39177v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep neural networks tend to rely on simple features that may be spurious and thus fail to generalize. We study this problem in the setting of linear probes, where a (generalized) linear model is fitted on the representations of a (pretrained) model. We use the connection of these models to the max-margin classifier, and show they favor directions associated with large eigenvalues of the covariance matrix. Whitening removes this preference by equalizing the eigenvalues of the covariance matrix. This observation motivates whitening as a preprocessing step that can reduce reliance on spurious correlations without requiring prior knowledge of their presence or labeled data. We examine the effect of whitening on a synthetic data-generating process and standard spurious correlation benchmarks, and find that it improves robustness. We also find that whitening can improve robustness when added to existing approaches.

本文研究尖峰模型下高维小样本（HDLSS）设置中支持向量机（SVM）的渐近性质。现有的HDLSS背景下SVM理论依赖于HDLSS数据的几何表示，该表示要求协方差矩阵的特征值不占主导地位。我们首先证明在尖峰模型下这种几何表示并不成立。我们证明HDLSS数据的Gram矩阵依分布收敛于一个随机矩阵，也就是说，HDLSS数据收敛到有限维空间中的随机构型，该空间的维度由尖峰的个数决定。我们证明SVM的误分类率不会趋于零，即SVM不满足相合性。我们还证明了偏差校正SVM（BC-SVM）在该设置下无法给出更优的性能，因为偏差项本身需要被修改……

The existing theory of the SVM in the HDLSS context relies on the geometric representation of HDLSS data, which requires that the eigenvalues of the covariance matrices are not dominant. We first show that the geometric representation does not hold under the spiked model. We show that the misclassification rates of the SVM do not tend to zero, that is, the SVM does not hold the consistency property. arXiv:2609.39164v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Score-based variational inference (VI) provides an alternative to Kullback--Leibler (KL)-based VI by minimizing the Fisher divergence between the variational distribution and the target. https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39151

该研究发现，在需要记忆的机器人空气曲棍球防守任务中，仅需64维的纯线性循环记忆即可蒸馏DreamerV3世界模型教师策略，其表现与GRU基线及教师策略相当，而加入非线性创新项并无额外收益。

依赖记忆的控制是否需要非线性循环动力学？我们研究了冰球跟踪暂时丢失情况下的仿真空气曲棍球防守任务。DreamerV3教师策略在跟踪丢失的情况下优于无记忆策略，而重置教师的循环状态会显著降低其性能，这证明了该任务需要记忆能力。我们将该教师策略蒸馏为具有64维状态的紧凑循环策略，其采用对角线性循环与可选的秩为k的非线性创新项的组合，同时保留非线性观测编码器和动作头。在五个匹配的随机种子上，纯线性循环模型（k=0）在测试的整个跟踪丢失范围内都与GRU基线和教师策略表现相当，而增加非线性创新项的秩并未带来可测量的收益。该结果是在一个全新的测试集上获得的，该测试集只有在所有模型和分析都冻结之后才会开放。

Across five matched seeds, the purely linear recurrent model ($k=0$) matches both the GRU baseline and the teacher throughout the tested range of tracking loss. item.description:
常数步长SGD的精确平稳高斯逼近

Sharp Stationary Gaussian Approximation for Constant-Stepsize SGD

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39144

该论文证明了常数步长SGD平稳分布的精确高斯逼近——归一化迭代点在1-Wasserstein距离下以 $O(\sqrt{\alpha})$ 速率收敛于极限高斯分布，并通过四状态例子给出匹配下界，揭示即使噪声对称且时间上不相关，三阶混合矩仍是主导修正来源。

我们针对常数步长SGD的不变分布证明了一个精确的高斯逼近，其中加性噪声有界且由外生的一致遍历马尔可夫链生成。对于具有Lipschitz Hessian矩阵和非退化长期噪声协方差的光滑强凸目标函数，以步长平方根归一化的中心化迭代点在1-Wasserstein距离下与其极限高斯分布的偏差为 $O(\sqrt{\alpha})$。证明方法结合了分块高斯比较与长期收缩技术。一个四状态例子给出了匹配的下界，尽管该例子中单时点噪声的边缘分布是对称的，且所有非零滞后的自协方差均为零。在此例子中，相邻的三阶混合矩产生了主要的修正项。

arXiv:2609.39144v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove a sharp Gaussian approximation for the invariant law of constant-stepsize SGD with bounded additive noise generated by an exogenous uniformly ergodic Markov chain. For a smooth, strongly convex objective with a Lipschitz Hessian and nondegenerate long-run noise covariance, the centered iterate normalized by the square root of the stepsize is $O(\sqrt{\alpha})$-close in 1-Wasserstein distance to its limiting Gaussian. The proof combines blockwise Gaussian comparison with long-run contraction. A four-state example gives a matching lower bound although the one-time noise marginal is symmetric and every nonzero-lag autocovariance vanishes. In this example, an adjacent third-order mixed moment produces the leading correction.

item.description:
RefCon：面向上下文演化智能体的迭代精炼与对比式记忆提取

RefCon: Iterative Refinement and Contrastive Memory Extraction for Context-Evolving Agent

RefCon通过将序列式自我精炼与并行式自我对比相结合，在无需黄金标签的情况下提取更高质量的智能体记忆，在多个基准上相对无扩展基线显著提升（最高35.5%），并能泛化至软件工程任务且超越真值基线。

长时程智能体交互会产生有用但含噪声的经验，而通过重新训练模型来吸收这些经验代价高昂。因此，上下文演化智能体需要一种无需依赖黄金标签、且能随测试时计算量增加而不断提升的记忆提取方法。我们提出RefCon，它将序列式自我精炼与并行式自我对比相结合，在无黄金标签的情况下提取更高质量的记忆。在AppWorld和BFCL-V3上、跨多个上下文演化智能体框架进行评估，RefCon带来了强劲且一致的收益，包括相比无扩展基线在ACE上相对提升21.6%、在ReMe上相对提升16.6%，而一个侧重多样性的变体在ReasoningBank上取得了35.5%的提升。RefCon在无真值标签的情况下持续优于现有基线，并能跨不同模型规模泛化、迁移至软件工程任务，在这些任务上甚至超越了真值基线。

We propose RefCon, which combines sequential self-refinement with parallel self-contrast to extract higher-quality memories without gold labels. Evaluated on AppWorld and BFCL-V3 across multiple context-evolving agent frameworks, RefCon delivers strong and consistent gains, including relative improvements of 21.6% on ACE and 16.6% on ReMe over no-scaling baselines, while a diversity-focused variant (DivCon) achieves a 35.5% gain on ReasoningBank. item.description:
ID平衡：基于PID负载控制实现极稀疏MoE的稳定训练

ID Balancing: Stable Training of Extremely Sparse MoE via PID-Based Load Control

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39137

该论文提出ID平衡方法，将现有无辅助损失负载均衡方法统一为不完整的PID控制器，并设计一种根据负载误差缩放积分项、仅在不均衡恶化时激活微分项的积分-微分控制器，从而实现极稀疏MoE的稳定训练。

通过混合专家对大语言模型（LLM）进行扩展，能够在每token计算量近乎恒定的情况下实现参数量的大幅增长。然而，进一步扩大参数规模需要日益稀疏的路由，专家负载不均衡问题也随之加剧。这种不均衡降低了参数利用率和训练效率，并可能破坏训练稳定性，成为可靠扩展的瓶颈。在本工作中，我们将两种代表性的无辅助损失方法统一为不完整的比例-积分-微分（PID）控制器：DeepSeek的无损方法相当于固定步长的积分控制器，而Kimi K3的分位数平衡则相当于广义的比例控制器。基于这一控制论视角，我们提出了ID平衡——一种积分-微分（ID）控制器。它根据负载误差对积分项进行缩放，并仅在不均衡恶化时激活微分项，从而实现更强的纠偏能力……

However, further scaling the parameter count requires increasingly sparse routing, where expert load imbalance becomes more severe. This imbalance reduces parameter utilization and training efficiency, and can undermine training stability, becoming a bottleneck to reliable scaling. Building on this control perspective, we propose ID Balancing, an Integral-Derivative controller. item.title: 本文提出HBM-HBF-主机三层存储架构与缓冲缓存感知调度机制，系统评估了高带宽闪存在高吞吐量LLM智能体服务中何时能够有效提升服务性能与能效。
item.description:
面向大语言模型服务的高带宽闪存特性分析

Characterizing High Bandwidth Flash for LLM Serving

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39131

本文提出HBM-HBF-主机三层存储架构与缓冲缓存感知调度机制，系统评估了高带宽闪存在高吞吐量LLM智能体服务中何时能够有效提升服务性能与能效。

大语言模型（LLM）服务需要大量内存来存储模型权重和KV缓存。随着模型规模不断增大、上下文长度不断增加，内存容量和带宽日益成为服务性能的瓶颈。智能体工作负载通过在不断增长的上下文上进行反复交互，进一步加剧了这一压力，使得保留KV状态以供重复使用变得愈发重要。高带宽闪存为扩展大语言模型服务的加速器内存容量提供了一种途径，但其访问成本和有限的写入寿命使其应用变得复杂。我们从系统设计和调度选择的角度评估了HBF在高吞吐量智能体服务中的表现，以了解何时增加的容量能够提升服务性能和能效。我们提出了HBM-HBF-主机分层存储系统和缓冲缓存感知调度方法，并使用基于追踪的仿真来分析它们对性能和能耗的影响。

arXiv:2609.39131v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving requires substantial memory to store model weights and KV caches. As models grow larger and contexts become longer, memory capacity and bandwidth increasingly become bottlenecks for serving performance. Agentic workloads compound this pressure through repeated interactions over growing contexts, making it increasingly important to retain KV state for reuse. High-bandwidth flash (HBF) offers a way to expand accelerator memory capacity for large language model (LLM) serving, but its access costs and limited write endurance complicate its use. We evaluate HBF for high-throughput agentic serving across system design and scheduling choices to understand when additional capacity improves serving performance and energy efficiency. item.description:
CDMD：一种面向表格数据的跨数据集混合类型扩散模型

CDMD: A Cross-Dataset Mixed-Type Diffusion Model for Tabular Data

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39124

CDMD是一种直接在混合类型特征空间上定义扩散过程、可在具有不同模式的异构数据集上联合训练的表格扩散模型，通过模式受限的反向过程参数化和共享的模式感知Transformer去噪器，实现了跨数据集的知识迁移与端到端训练。

表格数据的生成模型通常需要针对每个数据集单独训练，这限制了知识迁移，并且需要存储大量专门化的模型。在本文中，我们提出了CDMD，这是一种在具有不同模式（schema）以及不同数量数值型和类别型特征的异构数据集上联合训练的表格扩散模型。与现有的在连续表示空间中运行的跨数据集表格扩散模型不同，CDMD直接在混合类型特征空间上定义扩散过程并进行端到端训练。为了适应异构的类别型特征域，我们为掩码扩散模型引入了一种模式受限的反向过程参数化方法，其中输出空间会动态适应每个特征的词表。随后，我们将数值型和类别型的特征级扩散过程组合成依赖于模式的行级扩散过程。一个共享的模式感知Transformer去噪器能够捕获各特征之间的依赖关系。

arXiv:2609.39124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative models for tabular data are typically trained separately for each dataset, limiting knowledge transfer and requiring the storage of many specialized models. In this paper, we introduce CDMD, a tabular diffusion model trained jointly across heterogeneous datasets with different schemas and variable numbers of numerical and categorical features. Unlike existing cross-dataset tabular diffusion models that operate in continuous representation spaces, CDMD defines diffusion directly over the mixed-type feature space and is trained end-to-end. To accommodate heterogeneous categorical domains, we introduce a schema-restricted reverse-process parameterization for masked diffusion models, in which the output space dynamically adapts to each feature's vocabulary.
